Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your night!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240826-3-900&t=3&akid=1831%2E135344%2EZJ1i2R)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

body:
This plan could kill democracy and a small animal at the same time.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240826&t=1&akid=1108%2E587540%2ERcuzDO)
If you watched the DNC last week, you probably noticed a lot of the speakers bringing out a big copy of Project 2025 and talking about what’s in it, Peter.
Gov. Jared Polis of Colorado even ripped out a page to take back home and show his constituents how dangerous this plan is. _You truly have to see it to believe it!_
One of our favorite moments, though, was when Saturday Night Live comedian (and former star of All That, Kenan & Kel, and Goodburger) Kenan Thompson took the stage to interview attendees about how they’d be impacted by Project 2025.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240826?refcode=em20240826&amount=5&refcode2=1108_587540_RcuzDO&akid=1108%2E587540%2ERcuzDO)
**[Pitch in $5 right now to help us elect the next generation of young progressive leaders who will🛑 the GOP’s Project 2025 in its tracks.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240826?refcode=em20240826&amount=5&refcode2=1108_587540_RcuzDO&akid=1108%2E587540%2ERcuzDO)**
Project 2025 is Republicans’ blueprint for Donald Trump’s second term – and it’s LONG and very detailed. Like Kenan said last week, this plan – printed into a giant, oversized book – could kill both democracy and a small animal at the same time.
Kenan interviewed folks like Becky – a woman who has been married to her wife for about eight years. Unfortunately, Kenan had some bad news for Becky: **Project 2025 calls for the ELIMINATION of protections for LGBTQ+ Americans.** 😡😡😡
Next, Kenan talked to Nirvana, a woman who only pays $35 per month for insulin to manage her diabetes, thanks to President Biden and Vice President Harris. 🎉
Once again, Kenan pointed out how the GOP agenda would set us back: **Project 2025 calls for Americans to PAY MORE for their life-saving prescription drugs.**
Kenan also talked about Project 2025 with Anita, an ob-gyn who delivers babies and performs surgery. “Uh oh,” Kenan said – **Project 2025 calls for resurrecting the Comstock Act, a law from the 1800s that would ban abortion nationwide and throw reproductive healthcare providers IN JAIL.** Absolutely enraging stuff.
Finally, Kenan talked to Sharia, a proud civil servant who works in the Department of Education. There isn’t any good news for her in the GOP’s plan either – **Project 2025 calls for purging the federal government of anyone who isn’t a MAGA loyalist AND calls for the TOTAL ELIMINATION of the Department of Education!**
Kenan said it best at the end of his segment: We all have the responsibility to learn more about Project 2025 and just how dangerous and ridiculous it really is. And most importantly, it’s on all of us to stop it by electing Kamala Harris as POTUS. 🇺🇸
But we can’t stop there, Peter. Leaders We Deserve is working around the clock to send young, bold progressives to state legislatures and Congress in November. These are the folks we need on the frontlines fighting to defeat Project 2025 and the dangerous vision that the MAGA movement is working to achieve in America.
**[Can you make a $5 contribution to support the work Leaders We Deserve is doing every day electing young leaders who can🛑 MAGA’s Project 2025?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240826?refcode=em20240826&amount=5&refcode2=1108_587540_RcuzDO&akid=1108%2E587540%2ERcuzDO)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240826?amount=5&refcode=em20240826-1108&refcode2=1108_587540_RcuzDO&akid=1108%2E587540%2ERcuzDO)**
Thank you for your support,
Leaders We Deserve

clean_body: I was showing all of my photos to my family, and I realized that I had to share my experience with you, too. | | | Wow! Last week I got to witness history in the making at our party’s convention. And what a week it was, Peter. I was showing all of my photos to my family, and I realized that I had to share my experience with folks like you, too. As soon as we got to Chicago, I had the amazing privilege of meeting DNC delegates and Caucus members from across the country, the Democratic Party’s top leaders, and even a few of the incredible speakers, performers, and content creators at the convention. We got to hear from not one, not two, but THREE presidents! (Presidents Biden, Obama, and Clinton.) Their speeches were so powerful. Kamala and I could not be more grateful for their support. I got to speak directly to folks, too. (Imagine that, a guy from Nebraska on the DNC stage!) It was so cool to feel the momentum in the room. Just like you: They want to bring our country together. And win this. What I will remember for the rest of my life is when the Vice President accepted the Democratic Party’s nomination. It was such a privilege to be with her in that moment and to witness history. You know, we have real momentum coming out of this convention. And we can't afford to lose any steam. Last week is proof that people want to be a part of something that is good. Something that is hopeful and joyous. And something that welcomes them in. We have to keep the energy up. | Only 71 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**JD Vance in Kenosha** I appreciated JD Vance coming to Kenosha to show his support for law enforcement and discuss the importance of keeping our communities safe.
I was able to join JD Vance on stage and tell the story of Kenosha in 2020. We shouldn’t forget that when radical Democrats like Kamala Harris and Tim Walz refused to stand for public safety in 2020, riots raged from Minneapolis to Kenosha.
We will always back the badge.

clean_body: Welcoming JD Vance to Kenosha, rallying support for our State Assembly candidates, and summarizing four days of the DNC in Chicago. | | | | | | Only 71 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail: JD Vance in Kenosha I appreciated JD Vance coming to Kenosha to show his support for law enforcement and discuss the importance of keeping our communities safe. I was able to join JD Vance on stage and tell the story of Kenosha in 2020. We shouldn’t forget that when radical Democrats like Kamala Harris and Tim Walz refused to stand for public safety in 2020, riots raged from Minneapolis to Kenosha. We will always back the badge. | We couldn’t let JD Vance leave Kenosha without stopping by Tenuta’s Deli, which has been a staple of the community since 1950. It was great introducing him to the Tenuta family! | Helping Our State Assembly Candidates Election Day is right around the corner, and we know Wisconsin is going to play a major role determining the balance of power in Washington. Wisconsin will determine whether Republicans can keep control of the House, take back the Senate, and win the White House. But we also have extremely important State Legislative elections we need to win. That’s why I held events with with 89th Assembly District Candidate, Pat Buckley, and 88th Assembly District Candidate, Ben Franklin. | | | | | | | | | | | | We need to make sure we get Pat and Ben across the finish line this November! # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended an anti-carbon capture informational meeting in Marathon in Buena Vista Co, spoke with a gathering of Democrats in Nevada in Story Co, spoke at the AFL-CIO convention in Altoona just outside the district, spoke with a group of Republicans in Marshalltown at the Pachyderm Club, walked with the Story Co Dems in the Lincoln Highway Days parade in Nevada, chatted with a packed room of Democrats in Emmetsburg in Palo Alto Co, and spoke with yet another packed room of Democrats in Spencer in Clay Co. The energy has been great out here in the 4th, with a lot of really impressive turnouts.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: It's safe to say something historic happened to our campaign last Friday that increased our chances of pulling off the upset. Kevin Virgil, my opponent Randy Feenstra's primary challenger in the Republican primary in the 4th earlier this year, endorsed me. He didn't tell me he was going to do so beforehand. It's been a pretty surreal past few days since. Kevin and I disagree on plenty of things, but I respect him for the bravery he has shown not just with that endorsement but his double down on it as Iowa's GOP has attacked him from all sides.
I'm going to paste the article he wrote Sunday on his X account here, and in the media section, I'm going to provide the link to an hour-long chat I had with Julie Gammack today about the Virgil endorsement and other things campaign-related. Let me reiterate before I post Kevin's endorsement article that I am certainly voting for Harris and Walz, so certainly I don't agree with Kevin's call for a Trump vote. Regardless, roughly 90% of what Kevin writes justifying his endorsement of me is what I'd write on my campaign socials and often talk about on the campaign trail. The below article can be found at the following link if you want to see it for yourself: https://x.com/kvirgil/status/1827702525643907098
Kevin's article endorsing me: Yesterday I declared that voters in my congressional district should consider voting for a split ticket - for President Trump at the national level, and local Democrat Ryan Melton for Congress. Obviously this is not a typical endorsement as today's politicians are expected to place party loyalty above all. My phone has thus been ringing off the hook for the past 24 hours. Many people are supportive, more than a few are upset, and I'm sure that a silent majority have questions as to why I would make such an unusual proposal. Here's why. I am not a career politician and never had any ambitions to run for office. I only chose to do so because our current congressman, Randy Feenstra, is so widely disliked. Most voters acknowledge that he accomplishes nothing, that he refuses to engage with his constituents, and that he has been bought and paid for by the national party establishment and by his corporate donors. Yet for the past two terms voters have held their noses and voted for him, because Republicans outnumber Democrats 2-to-1 in this district. And for most of them, voting any other way would be unthinkable - regardless of how bad their party's candidate might be. But that blind party loyalty hasn't helped our state, and has brought forth serious problems. Republicans have an ironclad grip on Iowa's political establishment. In fact, the last time the Democrats controlled the governor's office and both chambers of the state legislature was in 1965. That was nearly 60 years ago! And as of today both of our US Senators and all four congressional seats are controlled by the GOP. It's a dream scenario that only exists in a handful of states. What do we have to show for it today?
* Iowa's K-12 education system has dropped from #1 among all 50 states when I was a student in the 1980s, to #24 today (source: USNWR)
* We have the second highest rate of cancer diagnoses in all 50 states, and we are the ONLY state where cancer rates are rising
* We have become one of the crossroads of human trafficking in the US
* We are the #9 state in % of children living below the poverty line
* We are in the bottom 10% for mental health facilities and care
* Family farms are disappearing
* Small hog farms (like the one I grew up in) have nearly disappeared and the largest pork producing business in this state is now controlled by the Chinese Communist Party

Iowa has much to be proud of, and there are many Republican politicians who are working hard to improve their constituents' lives. The 'endorsements' page on my campaign website is full of examples of these good leaders. The problem is that our voter base has become far too tolerant of BAD leaders, all in the sake of party loyalty. Frankly, the only way that our so-called leadership is going to get the message is if 'we the people' demonstrate that we are no longer willing to tolerate bad candidates. That's why I am proposing a vote for Ryan Melton this November. Ryan and I disagree on many issues - right to life, taxation, etc. But he's pragmatic, and knows that Western Iowa is a highly conservative district. I believe that he has good character and will represent us well - certainly better than our current congressman. (It also doesn't hurt that the Democratic Party doesn't even acknowledge his existence. He will be his own man.) And to be clear, I do not make this decision lightly. At the national level the Democratic Party has completely lost its way. Today they are the party of censorship, of war, of protecting their rich donors, of unchecked illegal immigration, and radical social upheaval. I want no part of it. President Trump is the only logical choice at the top of the ticket and I intend to support him. But at the same time, Iowa's fortunes have deteriorated after six decades of one-party leadership in this state. We need elected officials who will ask hard questions about the serious issues:
* What is the linkage between glyphosate herbicides and pesticides, and our sky-high cancer rates?
* Why are our politicians so eager to sell out our constitutional rights for a CO2 pipeline when a recent poll showed that 78% of Iowans oppose it?
* Why are our leaders so beholden to corporate donors instead of their constituents?

In short, the Republican party needs a serious wake-up call. We need better leaders who remember that they represent "we the people" and not Big Ag. I have heard from hundreds, if not thousands, of voters who intend to write in my name on the ballot this November in the general election. I am so grateful for their support. However as we all know, 99.9% of write-in campaigns are unsuccessful and I urge them to use their vote more wisely. I urge them to consider 'holding their nose' and voting out a bad leader, and sending a very clear message to Des Moines that our elected leaders need to remember who they work for.

Our schedule for this week: On Monday 8/26, I jumped on for a Zoom session with well-known writer and journalist Julie Gammack. On Tuesday, 8/27, I'll be attending Marshalltown state house representative Sue Cahill's fundraiser from 5-7 pm at Tannin Wine Bar in Marshalltown. On Wednesday, 8/28 from 11-1, I'll be with the Sioux Co Dems at the Northwest Iowa Community College new school year booth in Sheldon. On Thursday, 8/29 from 1-4, I'll be again hanging with the Sioux Co Dems at the new school year booth at Dordt University at the recreation center on campus. Saturday, 8/31, I'll be at a Holstein event with state house Dem candidates Dustin Durbin and Rosanne Plante at 10 AM, before I head out to Lincoln to attend the first game of the season for my beloved Cornhuskers. Go Big Red! Yes yes, I'm also a Cyclone fan, being an ISU alum, so I'll be rooting for them Saturday too. Sunday, 9/1, I'll be attending the Labor Day picnic in Fort Dodge from 1-3 at 712 3rd St NW
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://okobojiwriters.substack.com/p/could-ryan-melton-mount-a-political?utm_campaign=post&triedRedirect=true&fbclid=IwY2xjawE6SlFleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHdD8hUP7TKM-0neNR9p93dW5edCSeib7qvi1XzkGIYHVLohS1klT40HA-g_aem_icHtz30a_H0O6ApTmBYzRQ
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: on the road again! 🚚
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

By now you’ve probably heard about _Students for Life Action’s_ massive **_Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour_** where we’re sending out our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to screen the movie _Unplanned_ on dozens of college campuses across the country ahead of Election Day.

If you’re unfamiliar with the movie _Unplanned,_ this wonderful film is the true story of former _Planned Parenthood_ Director Abby Johnson who became a committed pro-life activist after witnessing the horror of abortion.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkjkht-duchtdja-y/)
This movie has become one of our most powerful tools in converting young people into becoming pro-life!

That’s why it’s important we screen this movie on as many Battleground State campuses as possible BEFORE November 5th!

So, in order to make the rounds to campuses across the country with our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck,** **[can you agree to your most generous contribution to help me screen the movie _Unplanned_ on the road through November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkjkht-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, our mobile billboard truck is a critical part of our Election Year Programs to EXPOSE the radicalism of pro-abortion politicians – something you and I know the media will never do.

Our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is definitely the most cost-effective way to screen this film on campuses.

_But that doesn’t mean it’s cheap!_

The costs of gas, lodging, and meals for our staff add up quickly.

**With the Abortion Lobby doing all it can to LIE to voters _(especially young people)_ about the reality of abortion, if we do not get our message out – THE TRUTH – we’ll fail.**

It’s that simple.

The Abortion Lobby will do anything they can to sink their claws into young people for votes.

Their bloody hands – and the hands of their allies in the media and Big Tech – will continue to be used to block the American people’s eyes from the TRUTH, unless we can count on you.

Thank you for your continued support for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

**[DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION’S_ ABORTION EXTREMISM MOBILE BILLBOARD TOUR AND KEEP OUR PRO-LIFE VIDEO BILLBOARD TRUCK ON THE ROAD >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkjkht-duchtdja-t/)**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkjkht-duchtdja-i/)

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWGgjrKWNN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWGgjrKWNN

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. ---
| MassGOP Demands Transparency: Unveils FOIA Requests to Expose $1 Billion in Secret Migrant Crisis Spending and 600 Public Safety Incidents
---
---
|
Boston, MA- On behalf of the residents of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, the Massachusetts Republican Party Chair has formally submitted FOIA requests to the Executive Office for Administration & Finance, the Office of the Governor, Legal Counsel, the Division of Capital Asset Management and Maintenance, the Executive Office of Public Safety and Security, and the Executive Office of Housing & Economic Development. These requests seek full disclosure on the vendors involved in the migrant crisis, including their payments, as well as detailed information on the 600 incidents involving police, fire, and medical emergencies in state-funded emergency housing.
Massachusetts Republican Party Chair, Amy Carnevale, released the following statement, "The Healey-Driscoll Administration has shrouded nearly $1 billion dollars spent in secrecy, leaving Massachusetts residents in the dark. They have withheld critical information on 600 incidents involving police, fire, and EMTs. Blocking journalists at every turn, the administration has obstructed the flow of information to the public. This call for transparency is underscored by the efforts of Senator Tarr and the Senate GOP caucus, who proposed an amendment to the Senate budget requiring all services for the emergency shelter system to be subject to competitive bidding and posted on Open Checkbook. This amendment, aimed at ensuring accountability and efficiency, was unfortunately blocked by the Democratic supermajority. Similar efforts were proposed by the House GOP caucus but were also blocked."
"Today, the Massachusetts Republican Party is standing against the veil of secrecy and the obstructionist efforts of the Healey-Driscoll Administration and the Democratic supermajority. We stand with the Massachusetts press corps in declaring: enough is enough. The public deserves transparency. Release the details on the vendors profiting from this crisis and the public safety issues affecting our communities. On behalf of Massachusetts residents, we are demanding accountability," Carnevale concluded.
###

The adjective "deliquescent" comes directly from the Latin "deliquescent-," meaning "dissolving," and the verb "deliquescere," meaning "become liquid." They suffered heavy casualties while allowing General Washington to evacuate most of his troops to Manhattan.NASA [will spend $14.6 million](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFutiAUgOGrwQ2DRwUdGP7F7fvXjoYPDnoaBAOo6d037dz5Xd48H6_1ZShQ3P6bA3X1aTW20o3rxEFxGNahcdojAvYN6k7BoKRUAppdWzvOo0Or3vDu_WSmWSicjQA5T4OVXUMaBAxiAtUJIce-tZPqvDCzdaPslPRsEOioptx-Jop1Rx--0o25telogt5rPQvr_zFYGCzP87TRFNNu6Waw7NdhYuEUeTmNRQbLT-T-iq7wUi9HWHhNvFznmXLlNuPDT8w-5cNEizxFHlLcuLuyqZQiP6gUSrEwWJqs3flQCFSkYoPYDkPh96r-bXRr-A4AAP__hwRsUQ) on studying the challenges faced by astronauts during lengthy space missions. ## Trump, Harris Battle Over Debate
Former President Trump suggested on Sunday that [he may pull out](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8Gd1h4jcFXULzG3b02pbWG5UwCxgLurPx9dKnTjTTFSPNxX-8YYjge_zGRaT6vaFt40Tpz0BzkKjtnPBHQ2JEZNEitlBbQ7Wa2Xk6bJXQkEC1oJ7ebkNM8-G0ab7oLBgRIMYMehFDT2NtZD17gzbpJDVp5JgW50HLpP3M42k4-fucXld7m1EWzt3ZWNv5jsDBYruvq7VYPuurbM1jeyGD5woQR-Y6lhMpdPjA63sozndzRho14Crbkc88HVZ6ejRgsXTHuvEKMoSrNpHgkDPG32_6-8DLwEwAA__-WT2FH) of the scheduled September 10 debate on ABC with Vice President Kamala Harris after both campaigns disagreed about the format.The Trump campaign had [accepted the ABC debate under ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO2yAURp8Gb1hwwSYZGFJV7vRnbEeLwLV9KwwWkFh9-8qdu33SJx0dnV9f85ejSGl9uh1tW_LsfKMPzjcOhoOedRfsggioOrTSgDbjaAR0mzWLki-FABDcCxyi0XII3stBoxru944sCNDiBkYKMQ6q9zcjF-HuPgyjNOPCtMBALZf-d6bUNlzin_zB0vu8d9FurR2VqQeDicF0nme_13R9DCZMnJDBlPCsDKYjR2rkr9nKez_45kqhyr3bD0drqtxHVzd-0XnAl2vIyzti5Sfy6ijwlLnfXFrxYrjCHw95VPXjydSUPQWmvn-7KuFZf2I5umLDcVKMVEfDtFh3R_Gfdvt_xI-FvwEAAP__hyZ16Q)the same terms as the CNN debate when President Biden was the presumed Democratic nominee. The Harris campaign has since proposed altering the rules, including requiring [both candidates' microphones to be live](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAURp8GNiy44ccZGLp4S9eO1jVcx1Q4WEDj9u2rdO72SZ90js7Hbb5hyulxf8edfF_LjKGnJ82jACdAz5pHvxIBXTh55UA7a50Evnm04CIYi4sKC1jESNpgMEHa6xVN4MmDBC1HcEpKay5DGJ1aJV5DNFY5uzItKaZe6vBZ0qNvtOaf8qQ6hLLz7Lfej8YubwwmBtN5ngN-p9JeL4PpxWYwyfG1LYNpw1pTE71-7YeItGAn0ejoQkmBSxAPOhuvPh5nyjk165iW9x1T_tP1_-OfHn4DAAD__9x9WqU) throughout the debate.The Trump campaign pushed back and demanded a debate on the agreed-upon rules.
## Ice Collapse Kills U.S. Tourist in Iceland
An American man died, and his female companion was injured, when [ice collapsed during a glacier tour](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOhCAUAL8GujX4RB4WFNfY7bVXGsDHygXFKJH495e9ertJJplkfp7T08YUt9e3XcmUkCfrS7xo0g_AB8hJ8tkEIqCOk2kRJCqFAvhiXO8Hslp2QoJrFfSoez-AQ-fCILHj0YAAKTRgK4Tqu8ZrbIOwg5971aIKTAqaY8lH85vjVhYK6c4XHY3PK09mKWU_WffFYGQw1lob5_zbMRg3qieD0R4l-kRv9Lvebi1IpTvzw8x7jSnFUyGT4rXamP6r5fPjZeAvAAD__y0wUsM) in southern Iceland, police said.The incident occurred Sunday afternoon at Breidamerkurjokull glacier, known for its blue ice caves, prompting a large-scale rescue operation involving over 200 responders. Here are [photos and drone footage](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFu5CAUANDT4A4LPrbBBcU2lraYbbe0CHzGPwEzAmasuX2alDnBk97_235zlOi8_3MZbY9ld77TC3fDQXOY9mkINiICqgGt1DDpZdEChsOaef5QZjUqODfpGIJXYfUhrlLOMixqIAsCJmFASyGWWY3eaBmFW32YF6mXyCaBgXqp42ehsx8Y07u8sI6-5CHZo_dHY-oPg43Bdl3XGByld3aURl_G5xeD7cSrMdhc7eQTcqm0Xs2sGWwNXfUH71fhmVqj8857eVZqvfGK7Zmx8b8ekzvDePSchmrD46KUqC2aTeL-4-Sh__7ysvAdAAD__-PNZng).Authorities suspended the search overnight due to dangerous conditions before resuming Monday morning.Officials reported that the victims were part of a [25-person tour group](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQxvGngc3IHI5NBg9d2NK1IzrsI7n2wJHtgvr2VTp3-6Tf8un_cZtvyML7_R038nVNM4bKB82jAqfAzKaNfiUCGlryvQPjrHUa2oe3C9AIFJGWaAZzIR0XxHgdRz3gdbAte9Bg9Aiu19pehi6Mrl81XkO82N7ZtTGaIteUu8_Ee33QKj_poNyFtLXiH7U-SzO8NTA1MJ3n2e1L2OksL29ges0XpCyxgYkDqYAHqZBE8FlIcSDBPaovFimqVzV9Zy5VgcJMqlQWURuXwvtd5bBjb8feDm328XmyCBfrGqPvG7L8Xar_Bzo8_AYAAP__FLVprQ) of various nationalities, with most tourists escaping unharmed when an ice wall collapsed in a ravine between cave mouths.
## List: Hardest-Working States in U.S.
A new study ranks North Dakota as [America's hardest-working state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAYAJ8GNlvwmZ9kYOjiLV07Whg-bFpsIkCmffsqnbvdcNLpPh7Lw8YUz-3dHmhayIt1LV643AbQA4hFUG8CIuBE0XANQiulGdDdOC2EB-7vcuJcwuoZk6jkimJdLTBJowEGgt1Ac8aUnEZ30zwwe3deKq5VIIKhjy2X8TPHs-0Y0k--sIwuHzSZvbVnJdMbgZnA3HsfQ_4WJ_b6EgjMLyQw2wNLdLYOuy0eaxt6Ll_x3IbabMNKi_HPHlOKVWki2HbYmP4S7f_hy8BvAAAA__8M1Fj4), followed by Alaska and Nebraska. The study considered factors such as average workweek hours, employment rates, and unused vacation time.Alaska leads the nation with workers averaging 41.6 hours per week, while Utah has the lowest average. [See the entire study here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79ugzAQgPGnMRvRcfEfMnjowpauHdHFPodrDY6ME9S3r9q58zd8-n1c5ytJlu3-Tiv7lspMocmL57FH16OedRd9YkY-d-wHh9pZ6wC7xZt04QjDaNBgSBSCI9D6ZlO6jUkzd-IRUMOIbgCw5nwKoxsS0CVEYwdnk9LAUVqpp88iW1s45e_y4noKZe2yX1p77Or8pnBSOB2UM7flefutCieOT4XTQjXy3vqj1C_Z7v3eqPHey9bTylUCKZwMaoCu-vg4JGfZrVMa7itJ_hu1_9kvjz8BAAD__7fCWqY).

body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4f3a2dc0fb8f4083bb6847a4185ddc97&_e=I5hnKgcDw0cBN6HS3I-78oBmvMq3otN3vwSwhpAtL3PEIL__tw-QyMnZls7v2AncQfmGD8RP_mBg01j895z2uI-_Iwh4JYcUEA5Yr45AG7G9M2IjEceSpQkGgFm9GfE7goRUouMrd4zAuZuE8akRo8WN13W0I9Pl9u5JYOo4uralei4jXgzetWswkqjLp-gdRNCZMmmJi_JMP2gaQBgwRSfPzpLkTZGTr8R3bmAE3Bjva5iPGJo5AsprskeOd8r7QSPCoXcX4m0juEnG81_k7Op8RNHl-Pc1UzBuZFdWO2wq5VFoB_r7vC3zhCIzeGEgvQj4cW-4WQJWbZHrwpE6AEZoNgSXBKxButZGPfo0WGyYwTg0NVTp1hTPn5lZHAKX8XeVj5q8In2do6ngP6Uajg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4f3a2dc0fb8f4083bb6847a4185ddc97&_e=I5hnKgcDw0cBN6HS3I-78oBmvMq3otN3vwSwhpAtL3PEIL__tw-QyMnZls7v2AncQfmGD8RP_mBg01j895z2uI-_Iwh4JYcUEA5Yr45AG7G9M2IjEceSpQkGgFm9GfE7goRUouMrd4zAuZuE8akRo8WN13W0I9Pl9u5JYOo4uralei4jXgzetWswkqjLp-gdRNCZMmmJi_JMP2gaQBgwRSfPzpLkTZGTr8R3bmAE3Bjva5iPGJo5AsprskeOd8r7gfyUtVL57GV7tcDRGWtDwjlRiCcufai19ATvQiQI9gghVJIpVc-hiji_s9Bt7w57P3TYFbyodPHQZPw6nFYwFxAXHWriLQEl9R7xuZejWLKVZO2yxW5ha8vEV-grddOPrE3N1oXtNmufLflk5-NIbA%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4f3a2dc0fb8f4083bb6847a4185ddc97&_e=I5hnKgcDw0cBN6HS3I-78oBmvMq3otN3vwSwhpAtL3PEIL__tw-QyMnZls7v2AncQfmGD8RP_mBg01j895z2uI-_Iwh4JYcUEA5Yr45AG7G9M2IjEceSpQkGgFm9GfE7goRUouMrd4zAuZuE8akRo8WN13W0I9Pl9u5JYOo4uralei4jXgzetWswkqjLp-gdRNCZMmmJi_JMP2gaQBgwRSfPzpLkTZGTr8R3bmAE3Bjva5iPGJo5AsprskeOd8r7ClC8TseEK7J1l1BNbuXhKSDaabeaD08chp1_cmyQSRno7VRqEGq4jsvREQI1YVZUCsN29BpPUn2iYVLy7eql_uLBj0XHcJibyXj0AR-9g6mKglyfGkShGjfgEN32I1iojru1bENTn2QKSzXMAHIJFA%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4f3a2dc0fb8f4083bb6847a4185ddc97&_e=I5hnKgcDw0cBN6HS3I-78oBmvMq3otN3vwSwhpAtL3PEIL__tw-QyMnZls7v2AncQfmGD8RP_mBg01j895z2uI-_Iwh4JYcUEA5Yr45AG7G9M2IjEceSpQkGgFm9GfE7goRUouMrd4zAuZuE8akRo8WN13W0I9Pl9u5JYOo4uralei4jXgzetWswkqjLp-gdRNCZMmmJi_JMP2gaQBgwRSfPzpLkTZGTr8R3bmAE3Bjva5iPGJo5AsprskeOd8r7XfKD0Byb-meOsp9EHNJMszj23CSder0c_kRyAgmmbSs0A8ivSQf3xtGsYwdrY05abfPyk_SET0SIrfGCb2PAC3Q3gqfCJLS2IelO9ZZ1_-Kg0xiv78z4e_RTNNdi2pA5Hpm1JnP-XXTpV2eiojq_CQ%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

On every important issue of the day, from out-of-control spending to runaway inflation to border security, Scholten's record has failed to live up to her promises and is well outside the mainstream for West Michigan:
Hillary Scholten votes party-line 96% of the time and failed to keep her promises of moderate bipartisanship. Hillary Scholten's entire 2022 campaign was built on a promise to voters that she would be a moderate centrist committed to bipartisanship. But when she got to Washington, she fell in line and was a rubber stamp for the left-wing Biden-Harris agenda. The numbers don't lie. That's far worse than most members of Congress, and worse than left-wing politicians like AOC and Rashida Tlaib. Bottom-line: after promising to be one of the most bipartisan members in Congress, Scholten has voted straight party-line 96% of the time. That's who Hillary Scholten is, so she should just level with the voters. West Michigan voters won't be fooled again when Scholten pretends to be a moderate this election season.
Hillary Scholten supports reckless spending that has led to the highest inflation in 40+ years. In a campaign ad last cycle, Hillary Scholten sat on her porch and implored: "Democrats, stop the spending." But since taking office she's shown not a hint of fiscal restraint and not a single instance of her calling on Democrats to stop the spending. She has voted against modest proposals to limit federal spending, like the Limit Save Grow Act. And she has stood silent supporting President Biden's proposed $7.3 trillion budget and the automatic tax hikes coming for Michigan families next year. As our national debt has ballooned to a staggering $35 trillion and inflation has made everyday life unaffordable, Scholten has issued over 80 press releases since she arrived in Congress but not a single one addresses the federal spending crisis.
Hillary Scholten advocates for open borders and has voted against every single border security bill. As an immigration lawyer and activist, Hillary Scholten advocated for "freedom of movement" open borders policy. Unfortunately, that radical view has carried over to her votes in Congress. Hillary Scholten has voted against every single border-security bill that reached the floor of the United States Congress. Every single one. She admits that the border is a national crisis, and occasionally talks a good game about solving it, but again the votes don't lie. Her open-border views are well outside the mainstream, and her record on border security has failed her constituents in West Michigan.

## Paxton Battles Group Over Election Probe
A civil rights group is [calling on the Department of Justice](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL-OrCAcRp8GOwz8QMGC4jZ2c9stDfJHySJMgFH37Tcz_XZf8iUnJ-frsTx0iCFt__XhVLt9XrRp4XSLxCAw8IV3Vq3ETrRzigrgYqQw8W5XclgNEQTY4AHEZIhmA5eGrtKvnPOpCwoIcCJBUDKMjPWCrIOX3ljP-Mi0R5w4G1oufdtdc7euPv7k05Xe5KOLam_tWRH7h2BGMF_X1afVJHfV949gfk8Ec9QtpIxg3vOrOlx0sBV_cNi6I5uiW8XfLuGnvltO-MwtpA2XsO2t4viK2uBikqajBDp2RdnnFWIMdRSIk-3QIX6E2h99TgW_AQAA__-VamoF) to intervene in Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's probe into allegations of ballot harvesting in three South Texas counties during the 2022 Democratic primary. Agents seized [65 cell phones and 41 computers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO3CAQhJ8Gd1h4zWG7oEjj7k-b0lpgOaNg8ws258vbR74-3Ugzo280v762L0w5nc-feJDldywbek4v2mYJkwS96S5Yp8IydGSHCfRkBlh0t1vwHmkxizPOgVFudoYmA6DduJjgsEsWFGg1wzSohxnHflLuEefoQxy1GTEKrSgkLrXnnZje2GL-W15Ue1-OLtud-buJ8YeAVcB6XVf_uyHfpoD1pKsJWD81AeuNErCq-daPO4614slNBmJMWWLO9ERO5WySd2SZKUgushFWv8sSZaCj-IqcvPR4hhSQScZS5Ych9_KnkYC1qzZ8Xynn1MwktHoemPJnMf_nwJeFfwEAAP__xM10sg) from the home of Manuel Medina, the chair of Tejano Democrats. Medina challenged this in court, where a judge barred device searches until a September 12 hearing. Paxton's office has been tight-lipped about the investigation, [only stating](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6yAQQNGvgY4IDwRwQfEad3ntlhaGISBhY9mjxPv3q02_9ZVOcb8e8yPUVrfn_7Cipyv3OUSqL5ydACtAz5onv8g0Dhz9YEFbM8CoefFgnFnikKWRbjRGhRjGaKUaIt4xmoVXDxK0dGAHeTdK3axc7tnlmLLSRoXMtMRUqR83Kkh4hTO37_7C4xb7ypsvRPvJ1D8GE4OJCpba2m9jMJW-4obvk8GknXZy1GIPF_VN7EdfUHw4kXDt8QhUo4hhSzUFQgYTP3za37W1ehrLtHyuoX5gTn88eHn4CQAA__9SBF9k) that they are "committed to protecting the security of the ballot box and the integrity of every legal vote." name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Defend The Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a2aebd6784de4faa889bab329e07a293&_e=gC-XJTgaS9fApw1f4mLByr9Z9Kg0LFA1jx8yAwZbxlzWS8e18solOjSXeM5_K9yTK9_-2i1UTFcpgiffA1RFCmsI3WN_zOepk-HINoRjxU5m7SakFzMRJ_KwfzdHa--Rb1JBeIFWjBM6EYsadVryiPOUJuNGlrnqG9fjLV3mh4zujF7pyC2pyCYBoyfs_j-Pz2Fxcg9sXY-1H8pjFtqWSv91ZeY5BCMO_OxwEuYWVkL3ZQ5WPYPierfCcRKSH97jJLM794K55CwWpjLAuGvSvMa4xFLKwN27NHsDgrvJn7qFu_Qq6NL0QMU0os4jENaL4jTm-6KzU0ArzP4j6NmzBHqqglvo2q1pEdR-o9VlK6plW669LkSpuDFAQ_UTCPDkztswCX0TWyPrSb1X1vp-Fg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a2aebd6784de4faa889bab329e07a293&_e=gC-XJTgaS9fApw1f4mLByr9Z9Kg0LFA1jx8yAwZbxlzWS8e18solOjSXeM5_K9yTK9_-2i1UTFcpgiffA1RFCmsI3WN_zOepk-HINoRjxU5m7SakFzMRJ_KwfzdHa--Rb1JBeIFWjBM6EYsadVryiPOUJuNGlrnqG9fjLV3mh4zujF7pyC2pyCYBoyfs_j-Pz2Fxcg9sXY-1H8pjFtqWSv91ZeY5BCMO_OxwEuYWVkL3ZQ5WPYPierfCcRKSH97jTvM8_nUYloDi3nmDrWSSzpyury3ql-j8tEegtvMIVMmILGtj5yk5ZoCWdZZ31F2Zn6bceLTKNn5x0v-B-eYc3fzt5C9KszmPQsPfROimRRKgKNcQT4eNNGGEEI4nsB5CRgW9jjsShrmSB-RvTgDPow%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a2aebd6784de4faa889bab329e07a293&_e=gC-XJTgaS9fApw1f4mLByr9Z9Kg0LFA1jx8yAwZbxlzWS8e18solOjSXeM5_K9yTK9_-2i1UTFcpgiffA1RFCmsI3WN_zOepk-HINoRjxU5m7SakFzMRJ_KwfzdHa--Rb1JBeIFWjBM6EYsadVryiPOUJuNGlrnqG9fjLV3mh4zujF7pyC2pyCYBoyfs_j-Pz2Fxcg9sXY-1H8pjFtqWSv91ZeY5BCMO_OxwEuYWVkL3ZQ5WPYPierfCcRKSH97jDfzw4GbxLD76lBb2h-GRlHXFjOtIz05s9IfVra9NWQOkQj7sDaELOfyTM2FwbU6h9CTjRdJYcWhXEObxx_YVfAGyM00ZzGNTzSeBTfsZQg23GOnNEzKheM0yG3KevDnt53WKdI-Gvt214Kw9gofotw%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This sponsored message from Defend The Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Fellow American, Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear. Our research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even greater reach and influence. Since Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription. | **Martin Heinrich is dangerous:** Martin Heinrich recently popped up near the US-Mexico border for a quick photo-op. But he spent years voting against security and safety, only to start acting like he cares weeks before an election because he’s losing to someone who does care. Heinrich has actively made our border crisis worse, with a dangerous voting record of opening our border and unleashing cartels and lethal drugs from China into our state.

**New Mexico Sheriffs: Yeah, right!** Several of New Mexico’s top law enforcement officials from around the state couldn’t believe what they were hearing from the MIA Heinrich. [Read what they had to say. ](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=6f4a0ddc97&e=780129cd82)
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | **Valencia County Sheriff
Denise Vigil:**_“We’ve seen an influx of illegal immigrants transported to and through Valencia County, and our families have felt the devastating impact of Fentanyl._
_“_[ _Martin Heinrich_](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=7da08f1172&e=780129cd82) _hasn’t done nearly enough to help us address these issues and it’s very disappointing._
_“I’ve been sheriff for six years, and I’ve never seen these problems as bad as they are now._
_“Nella Domenici is tough as nails and wants to address our border and fentanyl issues.****_
_**I trust Nella Domenici.”**_
---
| **Albuquerque Cops Endorse Nella** The Albuquerque Police Officers Association (APOA), representing more than 800 police officers from the Albuquerque Police Department and the Aviation Police, [has endorsed Nella Domenici over her opponent](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=650e523301&e=780129cd82), an incumbent senator with a record of complete failure.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=ebc787cd5d&e=780129cd82)
---
| | Heinrich has made New Mexico’s crime problem a crisis with his misplaced priorities, including following Biden’s and Harris' open border policies enabling dangerous criminals, cartels, terrorists, and a massive flow of deadly fentanyl throughout New Mexico and the United States.
---
| **Experiencing Ground Zero** Last week Nella hit the streets in Albuquerque’s International District with police officers to learn first-hand about crime in New Mexico.
Nella learned that fentanyl pills cost less than 30 cents apiece and are extremely easy to obtain. She also spoke to a neighbor who is sick of the crime that is so pervasive in her neighborhood. Her backyard is littered with discarded tin foil from fentanyl users, and stolen purses stripped of credit cards, cash, and any other valuable belongings.
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=02f5154dac&e=780129cd82)
| “I saw block after block of people openly smoking Fentanyl from foil wrappers. They wander the streets like zombies. They sleep in alleys only to wake and repeat their addictive behavior until they overdose and die.” said Nella. "Many are malnourished and dehydrated with sores on their skin. They prostitute themselves, and commit crimes, some violent, to support their addiction. The night belongs to the addicts and the criminals because everyone else is afraid to leave their homes."
---
| | | | | | | | | | | “Our law enforcement officers place themselves on the front-line. I deeply appreciate the work they do, and it’s time they had a United States Senator who will fight for them and get them the federal support they need to reduce crime.”
---
| [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=2379450498&e=780129cd82)
---
|
---
| **Indian Market:** Indian Market last weekend was a magnificent display of Indigenous Native American art— weavings, pottery, jewelry and so much more.
---
| Nella had the privilege of visiting with former Senator Ben Nighthorse Campbell who served in the U.S. with her Dad for many years. He was an Olympic champion in Judo. He said he recently gave up riding his motorcycle and still is up at 4:30 am to make his beautiful, museum-quality jewelry.
---
| **Sandoval County Fun** Sunday saw Nella and top campaign dog Paco head up to Jemez for a meeting of the Jemez Mountain Electrical Co-op, then to Rio Rancho for Sunday Funday at Haynes Park.
---
|
# _🐾 Paco’s Piece 🐾_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **Top Dog Dancer** Saturday was one of those “dog days of August” on the campaign trail with great events: the Jemez Mountain Rural Electric Co-Op picnic and annual meeting had Breakfast burritos!! Music!! Lots of smells to sniff!!! I collected a belly rub from everyone and shook a few hands—People shook my paw whenever I offered it.
[Carlos and Rita](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=c012fea4b2&e=780129cd82) were there. What great humans. People were dancing but this Campaign Top Dog—me— is a terrible dancer. Why you might be asking? Because I have two left feet!

USO Supporter,
The birth of a child. The death of a beloved grandparent. Weddings, anniversaries, first words, first steps. These are moments when you want to hold your loved ones close -- and moments many military families are forced to spend apart.
Even when their sacrifices aren't making the headlines, the more than 1.3 million service members protecting our country deserve our respect and gratitude. **That 's why we set a goal to fill this official thank-you card with 50,000 signatures via email and text message from grateful Americans like you: [Will you take a moment to add your name now and thank our heroes?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SIGN THE CARD](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/e-LPBjEYG6tZ/WUJReEwwdEdHNWlmdTZRb2toTVg4R3pwaEJZM3c0SUVNNlNrU010WWxua1hjSnRoa1NWS2ZIcHRwYndLZS9aWjI4TWxrbnk4VjZkblJtWWwrSThUR3g4cGhIQVdtT3pWV2xUU3NaWklTdkE9S0/alFBM0JhVWFpL0NScU5QRG9NZkhrc29GWUNCd3JSUm1Rdm9hVkVvbUdNMDZXcThHQUdMZHVFOHlQL0I2elhUQ1k4cWFtK3FoTVdBempaWnR2WDByVHNYREdQeWozRGRaS0)
---
The USO has worked tirelessly to support our heroes in uniform since 1941. From hosting legendary entertainers like Bob Hope and boosting morale during World War II to providing care packages and comforts in remote locations today, the USO logo is a symbol of home and appreciation for service members and their families.
We're proud of this long legacy of supporting America's heroes, and proud to be the **only** nonprofit organization that goes wherever our Armed Forces and their families go. You're a huge part of it. **And it 's up to all of us to make sure brave service members around the world know they're not forgotten, so please:**
**[Add your name today to thank our heroes for their service and sacrifice. name: John Carney
subject: What a week at the DNC
body:
What a week at the DNC!
Last week, I had the opportunity to attend the Democratic National Convention as a delegate. It was a historic week for our party and our nation. Here’s a recap from my trip.

Day 1
The first day of the DNC was truly special. We couldn’t be prouder of President Biden and all that he’s accomplished in one term. Monday night was full of gratitude for Delaware’s favorite son, President Joe Biden , for his selfless decision in honor of his country and our democracy. He is a leader we should all be proud of. Thank you, Joe.

Day 2
The energy and enthusiasm during the roll call was electric!

Day 3
Because I was in Chicago, I couldn’t knock on doors. That’s why I took some time Wednesday afternoon to phone bank into the City of Wilmington. Later, I was so proud to see my good friend and fellow Governor, Tim Walz, officially become our candidate for Vice President. This is no surprise to anyone, but I loved Coach Walz’s football references in his speech. 🏈

Day 4
I joined my fellow Democratic Governors for a lunch -- and got a selfie with our next VP . The DNC was packed Thursday night as we watched Vice President Harris accept her nomination for President. Vice President Harris is a remarkably accomplished and hardworking leader who believes in justice and dignity. Vice President Harris is exactly the type of leader we need as our next President.

That's why we'll be doing everything we can to elect Vice President Harris and Governor Walz this November.

Sincerely,
John

That’s why I launched the **Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute.** My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1833%2E135344%2ErHXi9L)

Yesterday afternoon, Donald Trump spoke in Detroit at the National Guard Conference. It should have been an opportunity to bring people together, or offer a vision for our country and our role in the world.
Instead, he spent his time in Michigan airing personal grievances, painting a dark picture of our country and its people, and, (for some reason) talking about Missouri.
And where he did touch on our national security or our place in the world, it was a vision for an America in retreat, rather than the world’s leading democracy. He would let Putin do whatever he wanted in Ukraine and abandon our NATO allies in the face of Russian aggression.
This won’t be the last time we see Donald Trump here in Michigan — not even this week. In fact, in a 9 day stretch, he will have made his 7th, 8th, and 9th visits to the state, with JD Vance also making his 4th trip to Michigan since becoming the vice presidential candidate.
Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
Trump’s visit — and his visit last week, and his imminent return on Thursday — could not be a more obvious sign that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.
For as good as the vibes have been lately, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. And political forecasters have said Michigan is a pure toss up.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
Because just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right back.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/27/2024
body:
First bills of special session released by sponsors, including five by Republicans
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey folks,
I had a blast at the Colorado State Fair last night working the RMV booth with our team of fellow freedom fighters! If you are headed down to Pueblo, make sure you stop and say hi (and maybe get some special RMV swag). 👀

This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, August 27, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[First bills of special session released by sponsors, including five by Republicans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Nine bills in the Colorado House and two more in the Colorado Senate are set to be introduced in the special session of the 74th General Assembly, along with others which have not been pre-released.
The special session, called by Gov. Jared Polis, opened at 10 a.m. Monday. The special session has a singular purpose to address property tax in an effort for lawmakers to avoid citizen-led Prop. 108 and Constitutional Amendment 50 from reaching the ballot.
Read the full article below for a glance at the Republican bills set to be introduced.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Their property taxes have gone up exponentially’: Rose Pugliese addresses Mighty 19 in opening of special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The special session opened with a continuation of efforts to refine property tax legislation through House Bill 24-0003, which aims to implement revenue limits and valuation reductions. This bill also enjoys bipartisan support, indicating ongoing legislative focus on property tax reforms.
* House Minority Leader Rose Pugliese emphasized the session's purpose as responding to constituent needs, particularly addressing the significant increases in property taxes affecting Colorado residents.
* The special session represents a critical moment for the "Mighty 19," the Republican minority in the House, to influence property tax legislation amid challenges of balancing state and family budgets.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Should Colorado’s constitution protect school choice? Voters will decide in November.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado voters will decide in November whether to amend the state constitution to further protect school choice, allowing parents to select from public, charter, private, or homeschooling options.
* Initiative 138, supported by Advance Colorado Action, could lead to a state voucher program by strengthening school choice beyond current laws.
* Critics, including the Colorado Education Association, argue it could undermine public school funding and lack accountability in spending.
* Supporters claim the amendment will protect school choice from future legislative changes and emphasize that the initiative does not create new programs or a voucher system.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Handouts don’t help’: How a Colorado county reduced homelessness by 86% in 2 years](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Douglas County in Colorado reduced its homeless population from 43 to 6 people on the streets from 2022 to 2024 by discouraging handouts and implementing a comprehensive support system.
* The county's initiative, "Homeless Engagement, Assistance and Resource Team" (HEART), involves behavioral health experts and law enforcement who provide direct assessments and aid to homeless individuals.
* The "housing plus" approach offers a range of services including housing, job counseling, and mental health support, aiming for long-term solutions rather than temporary relief.
* Funded by federal and state grants, the program costs $1.8 million in 2024, focusing on sustainable funding sources to maintain its efforts. The initiative's success is attributed to proactive community engagement and a broad spectrum of support services that address underlying issues contributing to homelessness.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump threatens to skip ABC News debate against Kamala Harris](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump may skip an upcoming ABC News debate against Kamala Harris, criticizing the network for perceived bias and unfavorable coverage.
* The debate rules dispute focuses on whether microphones should be muted when candidates are not speaking, a protocol Trump insists on based on previous debates.
* Both campaigns are currently negotiating terms, with Trump reiterating his preference for muted microphones, similar to past debate setups.
* The disagreement highlights ongoing tensions and strategic maneuvering as both sides prepare for the potentially pivotal debate on September 10th.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Secret Service ending protection for RFK Jr.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Secret Service has ceased providing protection to Robert F. Kennedy Jr. following his suspension of his presidential campaign. RFK Jr. had received Secret Service protection at President Biden's direction after citing security concerns and previous delays in securing protection.
* Kennedy, citing past threats and the historical assassinations of his uncle and father, had aggressively pursued protective services for months.
* After ending his campaign and endorsing Donald Trump at an Arizona rally, Kennedy's Secret Service protection was withdrawn in line with standard procedure when candidates withdraw from races.
* The discontinuation of his protection coincides with ongoing investigations into a recent assassination attempt against former President Donald Trump.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Grice: The last person in the room caused this nightmare in America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RICK GRICE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_For three-plus years now, a constant topic of conversation among most sentient observers of the American political scene has been, “Who do you really think is actually running the White House?” Susan Rice? Barack Obama? Lately, Jill Biden? Who?_
_I know that in countless conversations I’ve had during the Biden-Harris presidency, that very question has come up repeatedly._
_Now we know the answer: Kamala Harris. She has boasted that for every major decision made during the Biden-Harris regime, she was the last person in the room. Whether or not one believes that assertion, she claimed it so she must, without exception, be held to it. Therefore, she signed onto, and by inference, agreed with every disastrous policy Biden has put into place._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Republicans oust leadership in meeting Chair Williams calls ‘fraudulent’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 25** _About 77 Republicans and another 105 by proxy gathered at a church here for the second time in a month Saturday to decide the future leadership of the party._
**[Williams: Colorado Republican Party will sue to prevent special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 24** _Members of the Colorado Legislature are set to convene in a 74th Special Session on Monday at the Colorado State Capitol Building to settle the issue of property tax._
**_[Sonnenberg: It is ‘a great day for all’ in Logan County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL | AUGUST 23** _High winds and a daily summer storm hit the Eastern Plains again Friday, a common weather feature for this time of the year, but Josh Sonnenberg is hopeful to avoid it just once, on Saturday._

------------------------------------------------------------

** Carmela Attends the DNC
------------------------------------------------------------

Last week Carmela attended part of the DNC Convention in Chicago! There she connected with fellow Democratic congressional candidates, labor unions and organizers, spoke at the Washington State Democrats breakfast, and heard riveting speeches from past, present and future Democrats in office. The DNC Convention showcased Democrats’ (and some independents and traditional Republicans’) unity and joy as they rallied around the new top of the ticket, VPOTUS Kamala Harris and Minnesota Governor Tim Waltz.

Unifying themes are freedom, fairness, and safety. So, in the words of Presidential candidate Kamala Harris, “Let’s fight for it. Let’s get out there. Let’s vote for it. And together, let us write the next great chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told.”

3. **Hawley is already doing, saying, and spending everything he can to tear down Lucas and the movement we’ve built together.** We urgently need the resources to fight back against his false attacks.

5. **Your support builds exposure on the ground.** Your support so far has allowed us to make stops all across the state, scale up our campaign operation, and earn record-breaking grassroots support from every single one of Missouri’s 114 counties and the City of St. Louis.

7. **Josh Hawley is a control-obsessed politician.** With abortion officially on the ballot in Missouri this year, we have a historic opportunity to hold Hawley accountable for his extreme crusade against reproductive freedom.
8. **You can be part of something truly groundbreaking.** Lucas is running to take back this seat for real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country.
9. **We cannot afford another six years of Josh Hawley.** This is our one and only chance and we absolutely cannot afford to let it go to waste.
10. **This Saturday, August 31, is our next major fundraising deadline.** We have built a truly record-breaking campaign and it’s absolutely critical that we stay on track with our goals at every deadline from here on out.

| Wisconsin could determine who wins the White House and which party controls the Senate.
