# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3991%2E552475%2EfyRwhW)
I’m running for re-election to fight for Pennsylvanians, Peter.
There’s a giant map of Pennsylvania in my campaign headquarters with the names of supporters from every county because this race is about helping folks in all corners of our Commonwealth.
That’s why I’ve fought to expand the Child Tax Credit, so all families have the opportunity to provide for their children.
It’s also why I fought for legislation like the PACT Act, which helps Pennsylvania veterans get the health care they need after serving our country.
“All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor” are the words inscribed on the State Finance Building in Harrisburg, where I began my public service as PA’s Auditor General. It’s been the honor of a lifetime to fight for the working people of Pennsylvania, but the work isn’t over.
**[So please, chip in $5 or more to my campaign today, and let’s continue this fight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240827-1?refcode=em20240827-1&refcode2=3991_552475_fyRwhW&akid=3991%2E552475%2EfyRwhW)**

It’s also why I fought for legislation like the PACT Act, which helps Pennsylvania veterans get the health care they need after serving our country. “All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor” are the words inscribed on the State Finance Building in Harrisburg, where I began my public service as PA’s Auditor General. It’s been the honor of a lifetime to fight for the working people of Pennsylvania, but the work isn’t over. With gratitude, Bob Casey

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2tIKuAVASvlzuOBuVwkoXW4L9Jk7bTXZ40hK1FUzWgwvRDV2wSucZY91KnHCs2LJ5jRkQX98d6a-qsvvv5zQszfqLfrqSD-3pYYJVlSv6KgbdzBzxo5ENwQpMOmeWrqya_GpbGvfLdWMTKli58vK_MM%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2rKdKOBll-WGBHaQHz736db0vplUweMunPFFjIKqa5QTrSE9uRkk6xve-_BR-MJYz78ehoeDlQUrHhjCxm8WDzwZ-aMBIWMxPVmdklvI1ObEg-93cY2DphrZ_3-6Q_vR436qcAque1GOVE_3wANg_cI%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATt83AF8cPc2_ypMWftc8MO26LS-5wHGv-43tbIGNfYsCZVd-SCGLfT4jM-2lW_TqPp0vyWGDpFYcuaiMg8CkhMhR-l1YtBl7pcDAfjYkLtgRpLEBqlZpOavU6s_rK43bIgNVRwUBBbZe9RfKqDbr7rhibsK61umO0gVrZf3iEpsQ5Ut9lWEiIMx-_dKcXJK9jaFdstymx1F-BGOuZJUjtcim2W4Spnls3Hb2RJR9SnR-XKDD31_SPXbT9ins4cWqLqiGZxqyHOjaMr5OrpeHL2L2gLqnuj_2TijuViRo_O-L0j9YGIBriwXmbGQ-PyBFy9j6DD9SfCEZsndPA6xV86oWjfMPTb7cAHYsBhvcEvIz0%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2nVtyzbqFIhsQdUhYBgk6ru-XbvtIkPDnSP2xsFC2WEVyDp-f_7hWUHlz4k87PMm41dGsYzR0-1pCSWm9P7X-Y23UjQZwNEGardSYa1eXe87cpNVGirsJMjKaA-3N3tCMv3NSdLIJdtvSnv-LlsecLg%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2oYnzX7ksX1DF7lILdifTmW5jl5lm4pB_2lczgeQjKBbPkTbn_pctdlOuMRqFB7QJ1R-NyiISvXHmVoe_mLIy8uMXVTQY_1bqNMSNWeCQFYOTPvly1a3Th3Kfxq9ouTT1RCbrnRTCwLIrD5v8cD-wZQ%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2rISFQDx8SsSDvZ7JrJ4etTVchOnIBQ0bA--gBpE_fVVI08Weln9PRHZ1Z3JOcMPEXvguTGtcbTl8cv25c5DGpJrsfn5lCBtotJp7xASHBDxbvCNX1QMP7f72nT6GuYu4GrKl34TBVYAnBDWz7pBBAk%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=948c4f781a51427bae7cc0afa3a1b901&_e=Hb-vMG4X2_szqKJDjxbceCHJsQx4wMpY_SangYx2ABPFsZXgrgZBJqTukMkaWATtSy74QQLUQPNgecAAu1qHFWsd3QQJPwHJktFwHu_NeMmcFBAYYjGtmjRn9a0UdtxMc3Ay4AMVqgYmdEGB-tVxbA_UlH8RCwMGP8ACTh3CBULEApINRXCst_CYhqYNxkxq-VTjzhWbbEAG5N-1oZ1o6gGIg-TmTfgcz45uOj5FG24s41-QNPEdOp7W0lhVDnP_rDUlNc35fASZi8jHpjhF2tOdiMtyL0AnnW-BQslP7n0nzhS7_5r1of3IrbiZ2aNxANatrgAbgK5cQUaBgHEVBTGhUhGVzXyPpltfwqxqJTc7CmpkZLW-zggw9KmjEV74NRczqq56CjXdT1o20C4zhzk8IeKY6MncI-XJP93-dNk%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

clean_body: This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. body:
Give me a chance to explain

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a donation to Katrina Christiansen's campaign for U.S. Senate in North Dakota — yes, North Dakota. Please give me a minute to explain why this race is worth chipping-in a few bucks.
First, it goes without saying, North Dakota Senate is not one of the races people immediately point to on this year's Senate map. It doesn't get the attention of Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Montana, and Nevada.
And I want to be upfront that this is going to be a long-shot campaign.

**Let’s be very clear: Everyone, regardless of immigration status, is legally entitled to medical care.**
But invasive questions in emergency rooms will make immigrants less likely to seek out care out of fear of detention or deportation.
This harmful policy just adds to the long list of Greg Abbott’s attacks on our community: from SB4 to bussing migrants to installing razor wire barriers at the border, Abbott is a dangerous threat to migrants in Texas and around the country.

As a Californian, I treasure our beloved fast-food chain.This wildly successful business should be a true indicator of California's success and brilliance. Unfortunately, even a business so beloved is not immune to Democrat economic and law enforcement policies.Those same policies bring about headlines such as this: In-N-Out was forced to close its first restaurant ever because of the rampant crime in Oakland. The Democrats who did this to our state and to Oakland should be ashamed.I called for the Oakland Mayor to resign, and I called for Adam Schiff to join me – But unsurprisingly he’s silent on the issue.That’s because Adam Schiff, Gavin Newsom, and Sheng Thao are all part of the same Democrat machine driving California out of prosperity and into the ground. Friend, I think it’s time we go “Animal-Style” on Adam Schiff. Your contributions to my campaign show your support and a complete rejection of the 4-decade Democrat-Rule in California. disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
body:
| | | | |
---
| **RPVI News**
---
|
---
| **Krystal Hardy Launches Campaign For Senate - St. Croix**
Krystal Hardy, a multi-generational native of St. Croix, officially announced her candidacy today for the U.S. Virgin Islands Senate representing the district of St. Croix. Krystal has committed herself to the community as a former educator, volunteer, and cultural advocate, preserving the island’s rich heritage through her work with the Caribbean Dance nonprofit. She is now stepping up to channel her passion and commitment into the Senate, focusing on the key issues that directly affect the people of St. Croix.
"As a proud native of St. Croix, this community has always been at the heart of everything I do," said Krystal Hardy. "I am running for Senate to ensure that our voices are heard and that our needs are met. My campaign will prioritize serious infrastructure improvements to stabilize our power, improve our education system, reduce violent crime, expand access to healthcare, and drive economic growth by creating more jobs. I believe in the power of service to others, and I am dedicated to making a positive impact on the community that has given so much to me." Hardy’s campaign will focus on actionable solutions to the challenges facing St. Croix, with a commitment to accessibility, honesty, and transparency. She aims to address the long-standing issues of WAPA outages and advocate for reduced energy costs for residents and businesses.
"I have always prided myself on being accessible and transparent, and I bring a fresh perspective that is desperately needed in our Senate," Hardy continued. "If given the honor to serve as your Senator, I will work tirelessly to be a voice for all residents and to improve the quality of life in St. Croix."
Krystal Hardy invites the community to join her in this journey to create a brighter future for St. Croix.
---
| **RPVI Ad Campaign in Full Swing**
---
[](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=b9584011d2&e=4f81ceec6f)
| The Republican Party of the Virgin Islands is ramping up its ad campaigns to connect with voters across the territory.
We have launched targeted ads on Facebook aimed at engaging Virgin Islanders and promoting our party and candidates.
Keep an eye out for our ads soon to appear in the VI Consortium and VI Daily News. We're also excited to announce that a series of radio ads is in the works to broadcast our message across the airwaves. In addition, a billboard promoting our candidates is set to go up in St. Croix shortly and will be live to end of election season.
We are committed to challenging the Democrat-controlled government and informing Virgin Islanders of alternative options that better suit their needs!
---
|
---
| **Pickard to be Featured on WTJX’s “Comes with the Territory”**
---
| We are excited to share that the RPVI-endorsed Delegate to Congress candidate, Ron Pickard, will be featured on the September 5th episode of “Comes with the Territory” on WTJX Channel 12. As the candidate running for the highest ranking office on Republican ticket, Pickard will bring his unique insights to a discussion alongside the Democratic State Chair, focusing on the recent National Conventions and their impact on the U.S. Virgin Islands. This is a significant opportunity to hear directly from Ron Pickard as he shares his perspective on the issues that matter most to our community.
Don't miss this important conversation!
---
[Tune in!](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=42e82d4570&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---

| **Interested in Running as a Write-In Candidate?**
---
| If you're passionate about making a difference in our community, there are still opportunities to run as a write-in candidate!
Positions are available for the Board of Elections as well as delegate to the upcoming Constitutional Convention. This is your chance to have a direct impact on shaping the future of the U.S. Virgin Islands. If you're interested in taking on a leadership role, consider throwing your hat in the ring as a write-in candidate and help drive positive change in our community.
We can help with the details of filing and finding a position for you. If you are interested, email [admin@rpvi.org](mailto:admin@rpvi.org).

[File as a write-in!](mailto:admin@rpvi.org)

Peter -- this is for your eyes only.

As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico, but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing.

I’ll be frank--**right now, our biggest barrier is being underfunded.** We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Peter, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, [**but just $5 can make a huge difference in this one.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=61346b67fc5640a29b3513ce28f28726&_e=cvyKe3BtGDf1Bzlru2WhHz9Xh-xqDym6Gus8myagE7bynH8Vj5Tx2jOBFMsOix5SzsU0F40EUM4CYboulvrg-s_TqWdLhBq0sCrF_N8Qj583DW0N-OZ7wAQYbVp6J3MR3Q93IFUB0yvCa_rOZemAXmHIWSq-eIcda08215t5rxIgB5TkQPvLx0PwlfzY9QY9MVJUJfBrPiCpaboGNET1AkXY0QvyH-J5jcLlCblIJu4C9W0grUekPoZX0UbfsIEkA8z6arsqO9TeI0SoeIjgFBqLI_LvULk7IqA770YqiPSyo_OypRLd8JLNq3hOKaSq120dmeBV6p5ztEV3HQx2FBVIHwg1UdrLiQ1lEeWNNOzqeW21Hkx3YHWAkkdRtNEjxfrNexh5LNls4V7wHChkRumLtZ1BrXPSpCW3pPjGL_g%3D) We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further.

A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: As one of Nella’s best supporters, I wanted to make sure you saw the latest numbers. | Peter -- this is for your eyes only. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico, but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing. I’ll be frank--right now, our biggest barrier is being underfunded. We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race. Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us. Peter, here are the key takeaways: State of the Race: New Mexico Senate 1. This is a resource campaign. Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up. 2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella. 3. Heinrich has no room to grow. More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.” 4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually improved among Republicans without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters. Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further. A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election. With your support, we can flip this seat and retire Martin Heinrich for good. Thanks, Noah Jennings Campaign Manager, Nella for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. ---|---
| Peter—

As students return to college, millions are stepping into a harsh new reality. [**With half of U.S. states banning or severely restricting access to abortion care, young people are facing unprecedented barriers to managing their reproductive health.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91622659/494444468/663092193?sourceid=1149787&utm_campaign=25emcge-0806aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=college&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWEzYjhjYS05NTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B9Xre9qY44qNZxtp-ihBzVLkyiX4OQNmT0xSVcr-rOc=&emci=b3ab4f3f-f063-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=b9a3b8ca-9564-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) | [**LEARN MORE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91622660/494444469/663092193?sourceid=1149787&utm_campaign=25emcge-0806aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=college&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWEzYjhjYS05NTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B9Xre9qY44qNZxtp-ihBzVLkyiX4OQNmT0xSVcr-rOc=&emci=b3ab4f3f-f063-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=b9a3b8ca-9564-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237 "LEARN MORE")
---
Abortion bans place a heavy burden on students, and the impact is deeply personal. In North Carolina—which bans abortion after 12 weeks—a Duke University student expressed concern over the state's worsening reproductive rights landscape and its impact on gender equality moving forward.
> [**_"Going back to campus in an abortion-restricted state makes me incredibly anxious and scared about the inherent loss of autonomy you have over your body...Losing this freedom of choice threatens to put women back in boxes that we have been struggling to get out of for so long."_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91622661/494444470/663092193?sourceid=1149787&utm_campaign=25emcge-0806aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=college&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWEzYjhjYS05NTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B9Xre9qY44qNZxtp-ihBzVLkyiX4OQNmT0xSVcr-rOc=&emci=b3ab4f3f-f063-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=b9a3b8ca-9564-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)
**At the Center for Reproductive Rights, we believe no student should have to sacrifice their education or future because of where they live.** Yet in states like Texas, Indiana, and Missouri, students face limited options—traveling out of state, risking self-managed care, or being forced to carry an unintended pregnancy.

If you or someone you love is heading back to school soon, we encourage you to explore our resource: [**_After Roe Fell: Abortion Laws by State._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91622662/494444471/1777352126?sourceid=1149787&utm_campaign=25emcge-0806aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=college&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWEzYjhjYS05NTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B9Xre9qY44qNZxtp-ihBzVLkyiX4OQNmT0xSVcr-rOc=&emci=b3ab4f3f-f063-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=b9a3b8ca-9564-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) This interactive map, updated in real-time by our team of experts, provides essential information on each U.S. state's abortion laws and policies.
[**EXPLORE THE MAP**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91622663/494444472/1777352126?sourceid=1149787&utm_campaign=25emcge-0806aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=college&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWEzYjhjYS05NTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B9Xre9qY44qNZxtp-ihBzVLkyiX4OQNmT0xSVcr-rOc=&emci=b3ab4f3f-f063-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=b9a3b8ca-9564-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237 "EXPLORE THE MAP")

| | | Peter,

# **Landmark Court Case**
---
|
The Home Distillers Association just won a landmark court case that could change everything. Judge Mark Pittman of the US District Court in the Northern District of Texas ruled that Congress cannot make home distilling illegal. He challenged the interpretations of the tax, interstate commerce, and necessary and proper clauses that have expanded government since the New Deal.
Whether you are into Constitutional law or home distilling, this is the story for you.
Starting today, we are also launching our **Discord Server** to build a community around Central Texas news. Join at the link below and check it out!

But here’s the deal: we’re just getting started. There’s much to be done for the working families of our district, and we’re not slowing down for even a second. I’m approaching a critical month-end fundraising deadline that will determine if I’ll be able to defeat my MAGA opponent and continue this fight in Congress, and my team has set an ambitious goal of raising $15,000 before this Saturday at midnight. = If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately. | | = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Raul | | | ---|---|--- = The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Democrats in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi have outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.

Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

| My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there. Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned. But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families. I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits. After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need. Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor. He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity. They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them. That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona. But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, FIRST. And today, I need your help. [Please, split $25 to my campaign and Blue Amp Action. Trump is rallying his supporters alongside Kari Lake, and we have to raise a ton of resources to defeat them and defend Arizona.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T80616124-caa1-4901-9ffd-28449ea1b1d9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. Peter, these next 70 days are crucial.
The energy on the ground lately is phenomenal. People are excited to elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and a progressive Congress — _but we still have a lot of work to put in over the next 10 weeks if we want to win!_
**To make sure we can fund all the organizing and outreach we plan to do between now and Election Day, we’ve set a goal to raise $10,000 before we close the books on August.**[**Can you pitch in $3 now to help us out?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240827?refcode=em20240827&amount=3&refcode2=4240_420207_4Paaet&akid=4240%2E420207%2E4Paaet)
Pramila doesn’t take _any_ corporate PAC donations, which means your grassroots support is essential to meeting our goals and running this campaign.
Here’s what your donation would help pay for:
* **Our TV ads** , which are the most effective ways to reach a wide array of potential voters before they cast their ballots.
* **Our on-the-ground teams** , who are knocking doors to share Pramila’s platform and combat misinformation.
* **Our determined grassroots volunteers** , who phone-bank to ensure all voters have the information and confidence they need to cast their ballots.

name: Bob Christian
subject: Support Kamala? Support Bob.🤝
body:
President Kamala is one part of the solution to the MAGA problem. Another is a strong Congress -- which is why I am running.

** President Kamala Needs Help
------------------------------------------------------------

I'll cut to the chase because I suspect that you, like me, are getting a flood of emails asking you to support the Harris/Walz campaign.
This email is a reminder that supporting and voting for me, Bob Christian, is the way to get Democratic legislation passed to get to President Harris's desk.

We have 2 strong Senators standing up for Georgia. I want to be your US House Representative. President Harris will need a strong Democratic Congress -- in both the House and the Senate.

Donating dollars to me, your local anti-MAGA federal candidate, is the best way to support the next president of the United States -- Kamala Harris.
Donate Now (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=5b379f2023-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Kamala Understands the Assignment
------------------------------------------------------------

Axios reports that Kamala is already at work to build a strong Democratic House. (https://www.axios.com/2024/08/25/kamala-harris-campaign-biden-house-surrogates?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=5b379f2023-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) As the article mentions, Walz is a former House Representative himself. The Harris/Walz campaign understands why you (and they) need strong Democratic Representatives like Bob Christian.

** Can't Donate Dollars? You Can Still Help.
------------------------------------------------------------

In this election, I strongly believe it is going to be our personal relationships that will win votes. Talk to your neighbors, coworkers, and community (as you feel safe doing so) about why you support my campaign. The main reason I believe I am the best candidate is that I live in North Georgia (Dawsonville). My opponent, Rich McCormick, lives in John's Creek, a part of Fulton County that will be in the 7th District. John's Creek is a nice part of our district, but living there is quite different than living in Lumpkin, Hall, Dawson, Forsyth, and Cherokee counties. I am running to serve all of District 7, not just the nice part of Fulton.

Visit my website, christianforcd7.com (https://christianforga7.com/?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=5b379f2023-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , to read more about my position on the issues. I keep Monday mornings open for conversations with constituents. Book a time with me and I'll call you (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y2hyaXN0aWFuZm9yY29uZ3Jlc3NAZ21haWwuY29t&utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=5b379f2023-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ! Find me around the District and on social media. I believe we have more in common than what separates us. Let's talk about that. Help me by talking about why you are voting for me.

** Thank you
------------------------------------------------------------

It is the honor of my life to be able to run to represent you in Congress. I want to work to protect against the MAGA agenda. I want to fight for decency and our democracy so we can get back to debating issues. If you are with me, I welcome your support.

** One Last Thing -- Can You Vote?
------------------------------------------------------------

The go-to answer is "of course!" but recent changes in Georgia elections have thrown all Georgian's ability to vote into question.
I urge you tovisit the Georgia Secretary of State's My Voter Page to check your registration status and precinct (https://mvp.sos.ga.gov/s/?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=5b379f2023-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_08_27_03_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-5b379f2023-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

I sound broken record at this point, but this campaign is going to be all about turnout. It will come down to a few thousand votes in key states. The winner will really be determined by which campaign does a better job targeting and turning out their voters in those areas.
James Blair is leading the effort and joined me to answer specific, strategy and inside baseball questions I can guarantee you he isn't getting anywhere else. Check out this conversation for the best insight into how the election will really shake out:

## Will she or won's she - the Kamala interview

Well, it's Tuesday and the end of the month is at the end of the week and so far we have no idea if there will be an interview - or even if one will be scheduled. Who will be it be with if there is one and the biggest question is does it matter to voters...

# Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
---
|
---
|
## Note from The Host Committee
---
| We hope you’ve enjoyed reading about the latest convention planning news from Chicago. Our team is proud to have hosted the most sustainable, diverse, and accessible convention in history. This will be our final edition of Host Committee Happenings. You can stay up to date on all things Chicago by following our partners at Choose Chicago on [Twitter (X)](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9e1d2ec23b&e=e789b9d47e), [Instagram](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9fe2e91311&e=e789b9d47e), [Facebook](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=18120e5db7&e=e789b9d47e), and [LinkedIn.](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=146cea3269&e=e789b9d47e)
Thank you for joining us in the Windy City! We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon.
---
|
---
|
## Thank You Volunteers!
---
| The DNC would not have been possible without the hard work and support of our volunteers!
Thank you to the more than 15,000 people who signed up to support this convention!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
## Volunteer Appreciation Party
---
| On August 15, the Host Committee invited volunteers to come celebrate, receive their assignments and get excited for the convention. Volunteers gathered at the historic Wrigley Field, the second oldest ballpark in the world and the home of the Chicago Cubs.
The Host Committee’s Executive Director **Christy George** , Director of Civic and Community Engagement **Mo Green** , and Deputy Director **JD Van Slyke** were joined by Illinois Governor **JB Pritzker** , Lieutenant Governor**Juliana Stratton** , and Cubs co-owner **Laura Ricketts**. The speakers energized volunteers as they prepared for the big week ahead.

---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
## Welcome Party for Media and Delegates
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On the eve of the DNC, the Host Committee welcomed thousands of members of the media and delegates from around the country to Chicago! Attendees gathered at Navy Pier to meet one another and enjoy spectacular House Music, Chicago-style food, and a special lakefront fireworks show.
---
[Party Highlights](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=3778da3b8e&e=e789b9d47e)
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8500e3cee0&e=e789b9d47e)
---
|
---
|
## Neighborhood Tours
---
| In collaboration with Illinois Senator **Tammy Duckworth** , the Host Committee partnered with **Shermann “Dilla” Thomas** to offer his [highly-praised Chicago neighborhood tours](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=b6ccc97d20&e=e789b9d47e). The tours instilled a deeper appreciation for Chicago’s historic neighborhoods by informing delegates about Rev. Martin Luther King Jr.’s work in the city, the impact of the Civil Rights Movement, Mexican-American heritage, and more.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| 📷 Antonio Perez/Chicago Tribune
---
|
---
|
## Convention Sustainability Efforts
---
| Thanks to the convention’s sustainability strategy, the convention achieved the following:
* **18,000+ lbs** donated
* **15,000+ meals** served to local Chicago nonprofits
* **4,285,032 gallons** of water saved
* **57,866 lbs** of CO2e (carbon equivalent emissions) diverted from landfill

---
|
---
|
## McCormick Place Vendor Fair
---
| During the DNC, the Host Committee brought together dozens of local businesses for a Chicago Business Expo at the McCormick Place. Local businesses from all over the city— including **Pilsen** , **Chinatown** , **Bronzeville** , and more—showcased their goods and services to thousands of convention attendees.
Check out some of Chicago’s featured vendors below!
---
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9ba1d015f5&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Congratulations to**Sharon Ponder** who correctly responded to last week’s question. 36 years was the longest period of time Chicago has gone without hosting a DNC since 1864.
Thank you to all who participated in our trivia questions!
---
|
---
|
## 77 Spotlight
For our final neighborhood spotlight, we are focusing on two neighborhoods located west of downtown!
Like many of Chicago’s historic neighborhoods, **West Town** is defined by the culture brought about by immigrants. 🥙 Try some of Chicago’s finest international cuisine at the Portuguese restaurant [Porto](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=662730baca&e=e789b9d47e), Filipino bakery [Kasama](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=dded1eea21&e=e789b9d47e), or the Creole spot [Soulé Chicago](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=402ea7fb3b&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| | | | | | | | | | | 🌍 Get immersed in Eastern European lifestyle just a few minute from downtown. West Town features the [Ukrainian National Museum](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=860a1433ac&e=e789b9d47e) in Ukrainian Village and the [Polish Museum of America](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6f658d68cc&e=e789b9d47e) in Noble Square.
🛍️ Take a stroll down Milwaukee Ave. between Ashland and Damen, which features some of Chicago’s best thrifting spots, bookstores, and antique shops.
🧂 Catch a concert at the [Salt Shed](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d72ce3cae5&e=e789b9d47e). In addition to hosting must-see artists all year around, the Salt Shed was a hub for convention activities throughout last week!
---
|
---
| **Montclare** is a small, mostly residential neighborhood on the northwest end of the city. 🌭 Try a delicious Chicago-style hot dogs at [Mr. D’s Shish-Kabobs](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1ee869240e&e=e789b9d47e), a neighborhood favorite.
🇨🇿 If you are in the mood for some traditional Czech entrees, grab a bite to eat at Cafe Prague
---
|
---
|
## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week's staff spotlight is our amazing interns
For the past ten weeks, the Host Committee worked with 15 emerging leaders in a paid internship program. Interns were given the opportunity to gain valuable experience working with community organizations and federal, state, and local governments.
The Host Committee is thankful for their hard work and wish them the best of luck in their future endeavors!

---

---
|

|

|

subject: BREAKING: Dan Proft Friend, Ally Exposed as Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton Donor
body:
FEC records reveal that a regular on Proft's Naples-based radio show made large financial contributions to Biden in 2020 and Hillary in 2016.

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/592bfd6ac499/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10346224?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=75998c0d31) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=75998c0d31)

This IR e-Blast Powered By:
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Dan Proft Friend, Ally Exposed as Donation Record Shows Contributions to Joe Biden, Hillary Clinton (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton in 2016. (Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

Federal election campaign disclosures reveal that Julie Kelly – a close friend and ally of Naples, Florida based Chicago radio host Dan Proft – and a frequent guest on his radio program – donated to Joe Biden’s presidential campaign in 2019 and Hillary Clinton’s campaign in 2016.

In 2020, Kelly rose to prominence within the MAGA ranks talking about the events on January 6th – appearing regularly on Tucker Carlson’s primetime show on Fox News and other news outlets favored by conservatives. On her X account, she even includes “J6 conspiracy theorist” in her bio. But prior to 2020, she had built her brand as a local Chicagoland food blogger.

On Tuesday, social media exploded with screen shots of Kelly’s $2,700 donation to Hillary for America in 2016 and her $2,800 donation to Biden for President in 2019. Since 2003, Kelly has made
23 donations (https://www.fec.gov/data/receipts/individual-contributions/?contributor_name=julie+kelly&contributor_zip=60467&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to both Republicans and Democrats, including U.S. Rep. Elise Stafanik (R-NY), U.S. Rep. Adam Kinzinger (R-IL), Jim Newbuerger (Rep.) for U.S. Senate and Bush-Cheney in 2003. Donations to Democrats include Richardson for President in 2007, Friends for Harry Reid in 2009 and Alexi (Giannoulias) for Illinois in 2010. In 2022, Giannoulias was elected the 38th Secretary of State of Illinois.

Missing from Kelly’s donation record? A donation to Donald Trump.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
(Source: Federal Election Commission website)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In 2023, Giannoulias testified before Congress against book bans in public libraries – calling it “freedom of speech.” (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Giannoulias was also the driving force behind the legislation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) signed by Ill. Gov. JB Pritzker – making Illinois the first state in the country to outlaw book banning – a move that angered parents across Illinois.

Kelly, who remains close to Proft, is a regular guest on his shows and the two regularly share each other’s posts on social media. Kelly not only appears on Proft’s AM 560 radio show, but also on the Dan Proft Podcast.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/dan-proft-friend-ally-exposed-as-donation-record-shows-contributions-to-joe-biden-hillary-clinton.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Proft hosts his Chicago morning radio show – where he routinely talks about Chicago violence, from his studio in Naples (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/naples-based-chicago-radio-host-dan-proft-posts-comment-fantasizing-about-dying-in-shootout-with-chicago-police-despite-living-full-time-in-florida.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , where he lives full time. In 2022, Proft moved to Florida. In March, a caller called into the show and told Proft, “We’re neighbors now. I’m down here in Florida.” A visibly uncomfortable Profit simply replied, “Very good. Congratulations, Bill.”

In addition to hosting a Chicago radio show from Florida, Proft has amassed a fortune running Illinois political campaigns as a consultant – but sadly, an overwhelming majority of those candidates that he’s advised have lost. But Republican political consulting is a lucrative business in Illinois, regardless of one’s winning record.

Last April, this publication
revealed (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/04/uihlein-funded-pac-pays-political-consultants-142000-while-spending-just-3700-to-support-conservative-school-board-candidates-disclosures-reveal.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#:~:text=The%20Richard%20Uihlein%2Dfunded%20People,candidates%20over%20the%20last%20several) that the Richard Uihlein-funded People Who Play By The Rules PAC, in quarterly disclosures, paid three political consultants $142,000 while spending just $3,700 to support conservative school board candidates during the April elections. Unfortunately, the candidates lost, but the real winners were the consultants who paid themselves generously. The founder, president and treasurer of the PAC – Naples’ Dan Proft – received the majority of the consulting fees, totaling $75,000 while the rest went to two other consulting firms closely aligned with Proft.

During a pro-Trump rally (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/charlie-kirk-mike-lindell-stephen-moore-set-to-take-stage-at-save-the-american-dream-rally-in-mchenry-co-on-sunday.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=75998c0d31-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) hosted by Gary Rabine on August 18th at the McHenry County Fairgrounds, Proft was the only AM 560 radio host not listed as a speaker alongside Amy Jacobson, Shaun Thompson, John Anthony and Jeanne Ives. # Should Churches Display the American Flag??
### My Thoughts!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Aug 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,
I've been thinking about a topic that often sparks discussion within our Christian communities: **Should churches display the American flag?** After considering the significance of this symbol, I believe the answer is "yes."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7801f4bb-c3b0-4dea-8636-e32fd2ab5159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Displaying the American flag in our churches reminds us of the blessings we enjoy in this nation. It symbolizes freedom, allowing us to worship openly and share our faith without fear. Additionally, the flag represents the sacrifices made by many to secure these freedoms--a sacrifice that echoes the ultimate sacrifice made by Christ for our salvation.
Incorporating the flag into our worship spaces can also foster a spirit of unity and gratitude. It's a visual affirmation that, while our ultimate allegiance is to God's kingdom, we also recognize the nation that provides a foundation for our religious freedoms.
I'd love to hear your thoughts on this matter. How do you feel about the presence of the American flag in our churches?
I am looking forward to your perspective.

Earlier this year, I visited Commerce City, Colorado, one of the most polluted zipcodes in America, where the Suncor refinery has racked up over 9,200 Clean Air Act violations in the last five years. The numbers alone are staggering, but it’s what I saw that haunts me.
Children here are suffering from asthma, nosebleeds, and respiratory illnesses. Residents face alarming health risks, including cancer, all because of corporate polluters who are allowed to operate unchecked.
Commerce City isn’t alone. Across Colorado, thousands of oil and gas wells scar the landscape. Despite being a Democratically-controlled state, Colorado continues to ramp up oil and gas exports. Governor Polis, unfortunately, likes to go easy on polluters, and he has not stepped up to help the people of Commerce City and so many other communities being inundated with toxic pollution. **This makes it even more crucial for down-ballot leaders to step up and protect their neighbors in the absence of state leadership.**
That’s why I’m writing to you today: **I’m incredibly proud to announce that JanePAC is endorsing a new slate of county-level climate champions who are ready to hold the oil and gas giants accountable and protect Colorado families from toxic pollution.**
**[These leaders understand that this election is the most pivotal for climate action in history, and we can’t afford to fumble it. **Now, let me introduce you to the climate champions who will lead this charge:**
* **Marta Loachamin is running for re-election as Boulder County Commissioner in District 2.** Marta is dedicated to ensuring her community has access to climate recovery resources and clean energy jobs. Marta refuses to take fossil fuel money and isn’t afraid to hold corporate polluters accountable.

* **Jody Shadduck-McNally is seeking re-election as Larimer County Commissioner in District 3.** She accelerated the implementation of Larimer County's first-ever climate and sustainability plan. She’s been a strong voice in strengthening oil and gas regulations to protect her community's health.

* **Steven Arauza is running for Garfield County Commissioner in District 3.** As an oil and gas inspector, Steven has seen firsthand the environmental damage caused by this industry. He’s a fierce defender of frontline communities and is committed to adopting a climate action plan and strengthening permitting processes to protect residential areas from pollution.

* **Caitlin Carey is also running for Garfield County Commissioner in District 2.** She is passionate about bringing clean energy to her community. She’s a loyal protector of public lands and is focused on diversifying the energy portfolio while creating a sustainable economy for the future.

* **Naomi López is running for El Paso County Commissioner in District 3.** Naomi López is ready to make history as the first Latina on the El Paso County Commission, bringing vital representation to her community. A strong advocate for clean water, she is committed to tackling the PFAS (forever chemicals) contamination crisis and ensuring El Paso County leads in the green energy economy by expanding EV infrastructure. Naomi will bring fresh leadership, prioritizing the health and future of all residents.

Peter, this is going to be one of the most important elections _**of our lifetime**_ — and with so much at stake, we can’t afford for even a single Black voter to sit this one out.

In Afghanistan, the Taliban's Minister of Education has announced that girls' schools are likely to remain closed permanently, [affirming what was allegedly a temporary decision in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/a61e67c8-ad16-4b6f-912d-fa520829744b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Additionally, the [Taliban has now banned women from so much as speaking in public](https://substack.com/redirect/8d396206-1e32-44c7-a42a-087ef83215be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As a Muslim let me be explicitly clear. This is apartheid, vile, and inexcusable. It is completely contrary to the Islamic tenets of seeking education. Adding to the injustices Afghan women face are the now centuries of imperialism and western interventionism. A return to justice is key to protect Afghan women now, and in the future. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31cd7586-9a28-40f8-9fd7-7a0ac204b03f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZYm1nueEezTL-DfI1-Rptqv4Gaeq_RTSojKJoknJLWE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148195490)
Islam's founder Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) declared, "_It is incumbent upon every Muslim male and every Muslim female to attain education_." In his _Farewell Address_ , the last public address he delivered before he passed away, he declared, "_Do treat women well, and be kind to them, for they are your partners_." In doing so he emphatically crushed the patriarchal claim that women are somehow subservient to men, but instead established that women and men are equal partners.
More than words, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) ‪exemplified these teachings with his actions. His first wife was a wealthy CEO named Khadija--and she was also his employer. While the Taliban has forbidden women from attaining education or playing any public role in society, Khadija was a well-known and well-regarded entrepreneur who ran a thriving trading business. Far from condemning such behavior, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) praised his wife Khadija as the example for women to follow--proud, confident, educated, wealthy, innovative, compassionate, all while also choosing to be a wife and mother.
After Khadija died, his wife Ayesha was a premier scholar and jurist. She played a critical role in educating the early Muslims about the religion of Islam in the 44 years after the death of the Prophet. Ayesha also narrated approximately 2,210 hadith, or sayings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), covering both personal aspects of Muhammad's life but also important topics like marriage, inheritance laws, economic, social, and climate justice, and even about the Hajj pilgrimage. It is no wonder that Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) praised her knowledge, saying, "_Learn half of your faith from Ayesha_ ," a statement he made about no male Muslim.
In essence, every restriction and form of oppression the Taliban is imposing upon women is not due to the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), but in direct opposition to his teachings.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZYm1nueEezTL-DfI1-Rptqv4Gaeq_RTSojKJoknJLWE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148195490)
And adding to this oppression of Afghan women is the immeasurably harmful impact of imperialism and western interventionism. Much has been written by the devastating role Russia played in attempting to invade Afghanistan, and the response from the United States in arming the Mujahideen. Washington Post managing Editor Steve Coll details this extensively in his book, [Ghost Wars: The Secret History of the CIA, Afghanistan, and Bin Laden, from the Soviet Invasion to September 10, 2001](https://substack.com/redirect/0a04ae89-2a76-44a4-a6bc-122ed9d728f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Indeed, less than a decade before the horrific events of 9/11, who can forget when western media praised Bin Laden as an "_Anti-Soviet warrior on the road to peace_?"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/93d051ef-cc1c-48f6-ac21-67a5fa1637d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And still, prior to Russian and U.S. interventionism and wars, the United Kingdom played its part in [overthrowing previous Afghan governments](https://substack.com/redirect/e265900b-2511-430b-8a92-8a4fbd6eec09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 19th and early 20th centuries. But we needn't go back centuries or even decades to see the destructive role played by Western powers in undermining Afghan sovereignty and security from extremism. This is a contemporary atrocity. Before leaving office, Donald Trump made impossible the hope of a safe and secure Afghanistan by forcing the release of at least 5000 Taliban terrorists. As The New Republic [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f64497-bea6-4c0c-9361-34efbc099921?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> General H.R. McMaster [told](https://substack.com/redirect/3c6c13d7-2a53-405f-8f5a-a8e792f44e8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) CNN's Anderson Cooper Monday night that Trump, while president, sought to negotiate with the Taliban as U.S. troops began leaving Afghanistan, which undermined the Afghan government. As a result, the U.S. government forced the Afghan government to release 5,000 members of the Taliban.
This demand was not made for some concession or military advantage for the United States. It was a unilateral demand by the Trump Administration and forced upon the Afghan government. Is it any wonder that the Afghan government fell so quickly upon the United States' withdrawal?
The roughly 43 million people, and 22 million women and girls in Afghanistan are living under gender apartheid. The past attests to examples when Afghan leaders have afforded basic rights to women in Afghanistan. For example, in 1957, four years after becoming Prime Minister, [the pro-Soviet Gen. Mohammed Daoud Khan ](https://substack.com/redirect/0cb8eb5c-caaa-446b-a963-cbd290107f8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)allowed women to attend university and enter the work force. In 1975, [Khan proposed a new Afghan constitution that granted women additional basic rights](https://substack.com/redirect/0cb8eb5c-caaa-446b-a963-cbd290107f8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A volatile series of military coups, followed by the U.S. Government arming the Mujahideen in the 1980s to combat Soviet communism ultimately ensured those rights would never come to fruition. And thus the cycle today is not new, but a repetition of the atrocities imposed upon Afghanistan, and Afghan women in particular, for centuries.

| Late last week, in a historic turn of events, Independent Presidential candidate **Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. officially withdrew** his name from ballots across the country after months of being sued and suppressed by the Democrat National Committee. In his announcement to the nation, he cited attacks on free speech, endless wars and other issues that prompted him to run for the highest office in the land. But, no other issue has been more prominent for him - as a candidate and an activist - than **the health of American children**. Indeed, he has been a **stalwart ally in the war against medical tyranny** for over ten years.
Within hours of announcing the suspension of his campaign, he joined Republican Presidential nominee Donald J. Trump on stage at a packed rally in Arizona and **gave Trump his full endorsement**. Again, his rally speech centered on the **explosion of childhood chronic disease rates** in the US over the course of the last thirty years and said he is teaming up with Trump to **_Make America Healthy Again_**. This was a significant move for RFK, Jr. considering he has had a notoriously shaky relationship with the former President since the onset of the COVID pandemic in 2020. The question remains as to whether die-hard RFK, Jr. supporters will shift their votes to Trump, but in the race for President, there is now only one candidate who will **instill fear and panic in Big Pharma**.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 27, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Faulconer Slams Terra Lawson-Remer for Opposing Prop 36, Ignoring Community Safety**
San Diego, CA — Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, has issued a strong condemnation of Terra Lawson-Remer for her refusal to support Proposition 36, a critical measure designed to roll back the leniency of Proposition 47 and curb the alarming rise in smash-and-grab crimes that have devastated California cities.
_**"Terra Lawson-Remer's statement about not needing Prop 36 is both a dereliction of duty and an outright dismissal of the needs of our neighborhoods," said Kevin Faulconer. "By refusing to support this vital proposition, she is effectively promoting the continuation of smash-and-grab crimes that have terrorized our communities for far too long. It's disappointing that the 'defund the police' crowd that supports Terra Lawson-Remer is starting to rub off on her. It's so easy to support law and order in our state. Prop 36 would bring back consequences for breaking the law. It's time to stop the chaos, protect our communities, and support Prop 36."**_
Faulconer underscored the importance of Prop 36 in restoring consequences for criminal behavior, which he believes is essential for deterring future crimes and protecting local businesses and residents. He pointed out that the rise in property crimes is directly linked to the leniency of Prop 47, which removed critical penalties and created an environment where criminals feel emboldened to act without fear of repercussions. As supervisor, Faulconer will support measures that keep communities safe and create consequences for actions.

I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilC3qj3951zlxpTh4ec5wGokK9bG7vx-uhwWBDl0OomKT4vQvdfhEW-ZjSz7nr_rRTJB3svJQvRxHqsPddLSnTSUlKW45NVjw3y1Y8vei-Vm0VJ310kovkn6rCh0Mqhycot_DBgE-WZse2txD_UFujZXI%3D)
