Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilCx2eGeVJZgjHIx_3aBFNaWfiaVeE_ohsJ-eTxZzCQTlLWIBOvedcOmwp8Ax7r07F1DoM-h_V8nQcVnmZTeovoP77nkxSoPIHx4DNsywiArcwI_lgM0f7Shd3yMX3SmAj9btU5u_kh8U3d8LsNLFNtZc%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilC81DySJDP6SqFU63twP0vhotiVunKzHlHG2LDS2I77OpejT5zwywbQDaBBrqABY_wnhZMYM9fYWP7Ov-E0NXKdVKtbc6VLh_emnrj5-ePfLkOykSa0SlG87NkcFukFDdR2apG5LIRKCgfqL3MPpBt_A%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilCwPSO8y6I-Ac1_ahb9LnU8PINleDbXBkckiSDmYSbKX-1OkpCWdfHBbTm25mC4fj2bHhU83S3hcNNKBCI6-Gw-P8sTtT9it99Qqxb51PKA4l-EKEr1r9I_EFyyEn3ve625CaOywG6aALovfFOJ9KZ0c%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilCzg1e2KzrYmx6AMTm9g3_klDIG9SkxsJyKtHLufskcMW-VEQTbe7W8HHs27TXKsSCB6rOIPDqCmXq-0VCm2r1J6vMgUHe1SuMEFuFqi5rvvOYc9_QAdcGc0DVbFCENCrgadBpVTyzu7w9611QJ9j7Yc%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilC4ipUHw_pkVj4VLCgVlonFDBHQth_zTkpPSAS9Yt47pDIS97PaA5W0GiNhsf6uu9A0Iu0S_VgjXFR3Z4ZRAqOtyCSTzOrJRNJ1a78lWBpcmtckM11VIDlKgDuDc_BDfQ6MUqpDuM-t0iIlBWkgKiXAM%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT
ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE->** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d680d30899b944bea0dc47b18d730777&_e=EQk1GWrNYvBYTc1vEYUsdyb7S1LPKIiN3c3uB-J5WjoBLZr6ZAEaxvrSsxlkUv2bH20LQoQYfwY3BOGO2N_xKX2dyiNZQcPJW1SNQGXzV1xK7DNokbAqQDKk0jxnod_OIPr62Eimzu2HZeLvnBm-GlfXm6PLY3sqvNERLkwqnOA1Yp3JVuweIb6R61_G5D4DLbAQV5_F6JjDDmVBxCPy8SX-qjt0B6m41djeypkzxO5zxnuGeKYf9bT2EyNxa-uRNwxbi4JSDwiHxLE6W3ilC2VVxjYpX-pI6pGIzcZobso-GshSI6q8uCXIKbDDJH3ByLPD9VR77M99DLb07-ONBS3VlePe4Sgp5Y6tK7cKdjkcm4eAEqRFdWTY8boclXNOweF_ttJQosNIy-81ZlG-sF8CKeHz9T9gIVj3Ybc8vCY%3D)

And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Friend, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I wanted to give you an inside look at some of the latest internal polling. | Friend -- this is for your eyes only. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico , but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing. I’ll be frank-- We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race. Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us. Friend, here are the key takeaways: State of the Race: New Mexico Senate 1. This is a resource campaign. Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up. 2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella. 3. Heinrich has no room to grow. More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.” 4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually improved among Republicans without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters. Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further. A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election. With your support, we can flip this seat and retire Martin Heinrich for good. Thanks, Noah Jennings Campaign Manager, Nella for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **Peter, of the 8.4 million Americans living with diabetes who rely on insulin to survive, _1 out of 4_ have to ration their insulin to keep their costs down.**
Costing as much as **$350 a bottle** , insulin is just one of the many medications made unaffordable by the predatory pricing of Big Pharma.
For people living in poverty in this country, being able to take insulin – a lifesaving necessity – has now become a luxury. **And that is absolutely unacceptable.**
**That's why last year, Letitia James fought back against Big Pharma and secured a $35 insulin cap for uninsured New Yorkers –** **a major win for the roughly 1.8 million people living with diabetes in the state.**

But there are still countless others who need consistent, affordable access to this medication, both in New York and nationwide.
Letitia James will always fight against Big Pharma until they make insulin and other lifesaving medications affordable for every single New Yorker and American.

clean_body: | | | | | Do you think the cost of medications like insulin should be capped? | | | | Peter, of the 8.4 million Americans living with diabetes who rely on insulin to survive, 1 out of 4 have to ration their insulin to keep their costs down. Costing as much as $350 a bottle , insulin is just one of the many medications made unaffordable by the predatory pricing of Big Pharma. For people living in poverty in this country, being able to take insulin – a lifesaving necessity – has now become a luxury. And that is absolutely unacceptable. That's why last year, Letitia James fought back against Big Pharma and secured a $35 insulin cap for uninsured New Yorkers – a major win for the roughly 1.8 million people living with diabetes in the state. But there are still countless others who need consistent, affordable access to this medication, both in New York and nationwide. Letitia James will always fight against Big Pharma until they make insulin and other lifesaving medications affordable for every single New Yorker and American. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A trend that keeps repeating itself in our elections
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
While the September 3 primary date is circled on our calendars, there’s another critical period of time that I’m keeping my eye on

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2325%2E4032634%2EmSLN8N)
---
Our primary in Massachusetts is just one week away from today. Voters will head to the polls and exercise their right to make their voices heard — it’s an exciting time. While the September 3 primary date is circled on our calendars, there’s another critical period of time that I’m keeping my eye on: the days immediately following our primary. You see, after our primary, my Republican opponent will be officially nominated, and the floodgates of Super PAC funding and outside spending in this race can open. The front-running Republican nominee is a crypto lawyer recruited from Rhode Island to run against me. He’s got a Super PAC behind him that has raised millions of dollars from crypto interests to unseat me. This is a trend that continues repeating itself in elections across the country. Powerful special interests keep using their giant piles of money to influence elections: buying onslaughts of advertising against candidates who threaten their bottom line, getting their hand-picked candidates elected, and reaping the rewards of their investments when the winners tilt the rules in their favor. The special interest of the month in Massachusetts is cryptocurrency. And according to Axios, crypto companies have poured massive amounts of money into the 2024 federal election cycle — accounting for about half of all donations from corporations. | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2607?t=8&akid=2325%2E4032634%2EmSLN8N)
---
**
This is what we’re up against. There’s no saying for certain what will happen after our primary, but we do certainly need to be prepared.**
[**So, with one week until we enter the general election, will you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to support our re-election campaign in Massachusetts, fight back against special interests buying our elections, and defend our Senate majority?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2607?amount=28&t=9&akid=2325%2E4032634%2EmSLN8N)

I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4ozHIwRD3mKN2qh8koUcX-1Ak3iMJvaQXKBmPR5N_PAWH7pBtkAZ1SWy7AMHSD_yK8etSoTcRDf1OkQ5pp30CwBOLQW4h9rgT33ALvDmepD0t9mLj9UwTi2mqATMAAfMOSN0eUst0KmYfSTZodod-LQMJxinprQ-3YsoipZU5L6tfIEzJwvX1LnVyvbD_k_d7lnTpNx8KabvgD4EdWdKBTWJvOly_dOjXXZT7k3qIC0KCdy11RGtOhamfPt3yrt900gYb6oKvxGyNkg7SXK2b0pVKcXTWMuGhLrIX8hrUmbHaCEfBnmmDKxNG8TNnEF6UTnFpb7lCrlSlsZpeeqEHr0a_G9JaPxND3R3ETmkpZq27I%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4ozHIwRD3mKN2qh8koUcX-1Ak3iMJvaQXKBmPR5N_PAWH7pBtkAZ1SWy7AMHSD_yK8etSoTcRDf1OkQ5pp30CwBOLQW4h9rgT33ALvDmepD0t9mLj9UwTi2mqATMAAfMOSN0eUst0KmYfSTZodod-LQMJxinprQ-3YsoipZU5L6tfIEzJwvX1LnVyvbD_k_d7lnTpNx8KabvgD4EdWdKBTWJrDkGJas4BF8Ii1gqELNqkATdXKPZdESBqesUFi6pKb9Ot9Hr1wMlDbhZLr3HkXWWqiuSFFuDJgdOm-T1c_2g1G4I7trN2O9SL4TgFYwMxXFaOtZX3tZkWDfonlZFf5pzfi3sCZEnkpHfzjlCVJNV9U%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4ozHIwRD3mKN2qh8koUcX-1Ak3iMJvaQXKBmPR5N_PAWH7pBtkAZ1SWy7AMHSD_yK8etSoTcRDf1OkQ5pp30CwBOLQW4h9rgT33ALvDmepD0t9mLj9UwTi2mqATMAAfMOSN0eUst0KmYfSTZodod-LQMJxinprQ-3YsoipZU5L6tfIEzJwvX1LnVyvbD_k_d7lnTpNx8KabvgD4EdWdKBTWJvJl3XOSsKQ0DK0bAtCjuhbXy8qGder57hyF3EMug_xEUjJElmoLr7pFJlRpe-dNdwqW1gSI3EIbVwRyMGp1ljb6ChEsL7290qjCJaRWHfps3rTLnxHgEFXxJFC38lw9EOmv1nN938kVh-fqkOrMerM%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4oziyosCWPLwn7GXNpEa_XB5qHD-N00KBdo80JRxrEi-APXjopg4ILNd6FhO1XZUA0ddHd29W8vqoHdODS4ZgfkoqEl4VqrVfOmwnf5j26SEq2nj4H8HmbfWxGsiVZY-06yLzLlCryNCPfO_wF-cwZVw8K5uibrV22OEGW4eQzRZNp7GEuKkg9d-l2YD3TIagYSSHGbpTuqiLY6PV4PfTyfxF1_aiKGTZGg_3jK0OwCn4uXMom94iz_TZJs3GELGyM5nf7VA4Ct0jd7mE-XMt6dHQunnRnP5DfvGOM5RgRvEaAIBwTQCacla64qIYw0I-ynhM23dbl5YJdeKhRIhI4QZPN6Xc2H8Z9vmsEAXOR9Pss%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4ozHIwRD3mKN2qh8koUcX-1Ak3iMJvaQXKBmPR5N_PAWH7pBtkAZ1SWy7AMHSD_yK8etSoTcRDf1OkQ5pp30CwBOLQW4h9rgT33ALvDmepD0t9mLj9UwTi2mqATMAAfMOSN0eUst0KmYfSTZodod-LQMJxinprQ-3YsoipZU5L6tfIEzJwvX1LnVyvbD_k_d7lnTpNx8KabvgD4EdWdKBTWJpjgtPEp88Y7TLfz6b1sPM41_tpLHyjaNkBrNEn-L_viYgWBFth8rlO6_0WfPyneyIKshfP03qvCEmVhi2hJ-PQcw75bx017Ya34tb9p42515Abp8Dw-7dOpoGg62uakPCJW4VpMSLFw58YjaDwbmEQ%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0af6378b308b48e286a1f9a5bd45f3f3&_e=XjMoDGKnbEI8ZvX9YAVQ5FFNGlknpN_ElwmfiYLs6YKfG9j1BaKzdmU1t4NxR4ozHIwRD3mKN2qh8koUcX-1Ak3iMJvaQXKBmPR5N_PAWH7pBtkAZ1SWy7AMHSD_yK8etSoTcRDf1OkQ5pp30CwBOLQW4h9rgT33ALvDmepD0t9mLj9UwTi2mqATMAAfMOSN0eUst0KmYfSTZodod-LQMJxinprQ-3YsoipZU5L6tfIEzJwvX1LnVyvbD_k_d7lnTpNx8KabvgD4EdWdKBTWJu6Z198Yj_hdpR4YGOVklG4S0AIa6jPRoJ3_cnaIdpMBanSW3WMmV9q5R_VCl_2LYhUFehSoB18dqokxvN2xYc4jQ0fG3u3TG-7vnl3v8X2mu4-3gbm6s7jMhm0Fq9L60r5EshaL5bxtBLCkff7Y84s%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

clean_body: I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. Fellow conservative – this is HORRIBLE for our campaign.

Democrats are now counting on Kamala Harris to carry them in competitive California House races like mine in CA-9.

For years, California has been home to more competitive House seats than any other state in the nation.

What happens in these races in California decides the House majority – _and it’s no different in 2024._

Peter —

I’ve got to be completely honest: Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators.

I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.

But I was lucky — I had my mom looking out for me. As I got older, I had teachers and members of my community looking out for me. When I went to Iraq, I had my Marines looking out for me.

And today, as we run one of the most competitive races in the country, I’m still incredibly lucky. I’ve got you with me, and more than 300,000 people have chipped in to keep us going.

And honestly, I never thought I’d need to ask folks like you to do more than you already have to take back this Senate seat. But that’s what I need you to do.

I know you probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake that’s what I need you to do.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I want to take a moment to reflect on the 2024 primaries with you, but
before I do, [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240827.FQdCjy&refcode=em20240827-35942&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35942%2E1203867%2EGiMvDL ]will you consider chipping in any amount to fuel Justice
Democrats’ work to elect more progressive leaders to Congress and get big
money out of politics?

Over the last six years, we’ve had some upset victories and heartbreaking
losses. This is to be expected when you go up against opposition like
AIPAC, Crypto or other corporate lobbies, which are some of the most
powerful right-wing forces in American politics.

In order to have a shot at winning, we need to always be willing to do
things differently which means we are constantly innovating,
experimenting, testing our assumptions and reflecting so that we can use
every win and every loss as an opportunity to learn and grow.

Over the next few months, we will be debriefing the races we won, the
races we lost and the races that were uncontested. We are going to be
doing internal reflections as a staff, debriefing with the campaign teams,
partners, and fielding quantitative and qualitative research. As we learn
more, our takeaways will be refined, but here are some of our initial
thoughts:

* These races were wholly about diverse, working-class, progressive
power against Republican megadonors. Right-wing special interests are
threatened by the Squad in Washington. None of these races were a
referendum on Israel-Palestine policies, nor were they an intra-party
debate between the so-called left and center. At the end of the day,
the megadonors behind AIPAC are overwhelmingly corporate CEOs and Wall
Street billionaires whose profits and bottom lines are threatened by
progressive champions who support policies like raising taxes on
billionaires or Medicare for All. It’s important to note that despite
losing the elections, Congress Members Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush won
the vast majority of working-class voters in both of their districts.

* The Democratic Party largely remains silent in response to AIPAC and
Crypto's unprecedented outside spending. They do so at their own
peril. AIPAC has created a blueprint for right-wing Super PACs to try
and buy elections and lobbies like Crypto are already following in
their footsteps, and other big lobbies surely will too. While their
silence may protect Democratic Party leaders for now, and result in
some large campaign contributions, corporate and right-wing donors
will not stop until they have complete control of our country and have
silenced all dissent. That’s why the same donors who funded AIPAC and
Crypto’s ads against Jamaal and Cori are also some of Donald Trump’s
biggest donors. These are the same interests who have us on the road
to fascism, and they are targeting who they see as their greatest
threat: working class, Black and brown members of Congress who cannot
be bought. Corporate donors elect strong Republicans and weak
Democrats, their perfect combination to achieve full corporate control
of our government. It’s time for our Party’s leaders to stop being
weak and stand with the people and the Party's base. We must get
serious about campaign finance reform and take big money out of
politics once and for all.

* We are winning the long term fight, and we won’t back down. While Cori
and Jamaal are major losses for our movement, their races show that
what we are doing is working. As we have said previously, AIPAC’s
spending is coming from a position of weakness. They know they are on
a path similar to the NRA — moving further and further from a veneer
of bipartisanship to unconditionally support right-wing extremism.
They have lost the war of public opinion and have resorted to forcible
suppression of their opposition after years of progressive power
building in Congress. For many members of Congress, their threats work
and members get in line. However, this is increasingly not the case,
in large part due to Justice Democrats’ elected leaders, who refuse to
have their voices suppressed even under the threat of losing their
jobs. The coordinated right-wing opposition they attracted proves just
how transformational any single principal or nurse can be to our
politics — and just how threatening everyday people are to right-wing
interests, corporate power, and the wealthiest billionaires in the
country.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240827.FQdCjy&refcode=em20240827-35942&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35942%2E1203867%2EGiMvDL ]We’ll have more details on our plans for the future soon, but for now,
will you make a grassroots donation of $5 or more to fund
our efforts to recruit more Justice Democrats to Congress and pressure the
Democratic Party to reject AIPAC once and for all?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240827.FQdCjy&refcode=em20240827-35942&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35942%2E1203867%2EGiMvDL ]Contribute $5

Thanks for all you do,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240827-35942-footer&t=1023&refcode2=35942_1203867_GiMvDL&akid=35942%2E1203867%2EGiMvDL

It was incredible to be at the DNC in Chicago last week — with thousands of energized Americans who are ready to engage in this election to defend our democracy, stand up for working families, and remind their neighbors that there is far more that we share in common than there are things that divide us.
Fighting for these values is the reason I got involved in public life, and I’ve never been more excited to hit the trail in support of Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and great Democratic candidates in all corners of Oregon.
I was particularly inspired by Michelle Obama’s message (echoed by VP Harris on Thursday night) to “Do Something!” That’s exactly what I intend to do over the next 74 days. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240819em-plan]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240826em-ds [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240826em-ds]
But without free and fair elections, our work won’t mean much. That’s why I’m fighting so hard to stop my opponent for Oregon Secretary of State — a proud MAGA supporter who is seeking to end our secure vote-by-mail system here in Oregon.
I’m doing something because I can’t sit by and watch as a MAGA extremist tries to hijack our elections and undermine our democracy. But I can’t stop him alone — which is why I’m reaching out to you today. Can I count on you to chip in $5, $10, or more right now to help elect me the next Secretary of State and keep MAGA extremism at bay here in Oregon? I recently spoke with Larry Kudlow to give a rundown of the state of the race to take back the U.S. Senate. _Below is a snapshot of what I had to say:_
> _**MONTANA**_
>
> _We've got a great candidate in**Tim Sheehy**. He's a Naval Academy Graduate with 200 combat missions as a Navy SEAL, and the last couple of polls have Tim Sheehy up over Jon Tester. This could be the 51st seat. _
>
> _**OHIO**_
>
> _In Ohio - another red state that Trump will win by 8 to 10 points - there is a great candidate, **Bernie Moreno**. That will be a tight race to the finish, but I like our odds in Ohio._
>
> _**MICHIGAN**_
>
> _There's an open seat in Michigan, where**Mike Rogers** just won his primary. As we speak, the race is low, single digits, in a state where Trump is going to be very competitive and has a great shot of winning. _
>
> _**MARYLAND**_
>
> _In Maryland, there's another open seat.**Larry Hogan** is a very popular Republican Governor and a great candidate, so it's going to be another competitive race. _
>
> _**ARIZONA**_
>
> _**Kari Lake** is running for an open seat against the most liberal, far-left candidate on the battlefield, Ruben Gallego. We just got out of the field polling, where the race is tied 46-46._
>
> _**PENNSYLVANIA**_
>
> _Then you go into these other states like Pennsylvania.**Dave McCormick** is running against a vulnerable Democrat incumbent. Dave is a West Point Graduate, 82nd Airborne, a business guy, and an excellent candidate_.
>
> _**WISCONSIN**_
>
> _**Eric Hovde** is running in Wisconsin against one of Kamala Harris' most reliable supporters. You've got another businessperson - a banker - who is polling close to his Democrat Senate incumbent._
>
> _**NEVADA**_
>
> _Another great state that's very much in play is Nevada;**Sam Brown** , another West Point Graduate, was wounded in Afghanistan. Remember, in the last election in Nevada in 2022, they elected a Republican Governor, Governor Lombardo, but we failed to flip a Senate seat. That was the tightest loss; we had 8,000 votes when Laxalt lost that race in 2022._
The opportunity is with Republicans. Democrats are defending ten seats, and our Republican candidates lead in the three critical open seats.

**But Democrats maintain their brutal 2-and 3-to-1 financial advantages across the board. Our candidates are losing the fundraising race and need our support to close this gap.**

If the election were held today, I'm not sure we would take back the Senate. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Peter, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, [**but just $5 can make a huge difference in this one.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=54a84ad2cf1f4dfdb33414a0faaf09ec&_e=5J4gKq1rQHEfCxn76HTvXl0B8-1H67ZpN41v1-c6s79jRgb1XHps7MrNqfB-cYocYv-WpCamdp_l_ZUwNrCi8vWMRkSv4eeSE4IfzF568HgN0nYx-H_FJwQBoiZurYxm7wcSfbj3D5jFOjqwzmX2-FQryuBtQKreSVfNiakJXTt1fjtu7iZF0yElaWxo-7-881b7CqmLUvZG9Gb2uN_MxAKds5FQlyw1r0I0v0nQzPwZBNi6D8miSKau-dNco7DtsXOEyRuoOhxbg3r3qy7-6aqJTbz8RPX4UNR7sNWdtWf3RX7URJXknd0SxZnvMc0WmboSb5izPf6RDQxD5gaEv0yMGNbVJqHzWCNGxNuqMhcsFTMgtmd6bsJD5bBa6fnCidhg48es7We5RA_2Roq4wH8ywikDiUn13DL-56gpUeNao-GYkM7jiS7d2Y4aBwtV) We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further.

A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: As one of Nella’s best supporters, I wanted to make sure you saw the latest numbers. | Peter -- this is for your eyes only. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico , but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing. I’ll be frank-- We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race. Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us. Peter, here are the key takeaways: State of the Race: New Mexico Senate 1. This is a resource campaign. Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up. 2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella. 3. Heinrich has no room to grow. More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.” 4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually improved among Republicans without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters. Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further. A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election. With your support, we can flip this seat and retire Martin Heinrich for good. Thanks, Noah Jennings Campaign Manager, Nella for Senate - | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this [link.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=008789d22bd14c34be4666968e54f7b7&_t=qYsmV-sHVoTUZ47VqZCqaarxoXh7T6Umdw0HMXku9uyjsEWJWQleOST4HG3kvwvOibq4uCBHPb9lG-jT_wwddx9BI0cwQ9DGtdo2dZVlirmUtNR9Uzz3MW2VAIvf_C8M)

Friend, The Democratic National Convention just wrapped up in Chicago, and there's something odd I couldn't help but notice...
* The same party that cheers on the defund the police movement **had their convention surrounded by police.**

* The same party that says putting a wall at our southern border is somehow "racist" **has a wall surrounding their convention hall.**

* And the same party that opposes voter ID to vote, which is a commonsense proposal that so many Americans support, what does it require to get into their convention hall? You guessed it. **They demanded identification and credentials.**

[_**" Good enough for me, but not good enough for thee" seems to be the Democratic Party's new slogan these days.**_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=008789d22bd14c34be4666968e54f7b7&_e=4W41HQl8Qm24hReaELapQFxzjglrDMlYbpV1xAlRDQmMANIdjUIVGxjJxYjUd9w3Bs8dzpQcUS9eBUkut_lEET1aIQE_02aRnbYRK-N_i2KKjSwEUCIcpdCQO6hcupyAeF666i_z4AR3yJ1HCzo4iVIOZhjgvyBsEj2OxMfbKikO_SOtGU43MUZhe1iLYyjr89GuLxC02o21g94W1ryeW6irSu6yIH6weD6foEU2dPY-vWMlV0ZIr7mMNuH8tjJk72Y94rpBxIpFTW4KDn4YthdaNWPOJFCs6tghODorM3CaZZsIf7MJ-gMggCGL4axHCNehJLQccCoyiXz0ebxvuHGvEfggMDqp_z1TRUNb0UlyJfmVnNL5Y0FTlPe1f7dtYsV-g6d4O6SFxudl97zwuP_7lrOl9YxzGk4YNO3txC0%3D)
But it's bigger than just the convention, friend.

**Leaders who roll out private security for themselves while destroying the policies that keep the American people safe have no business in the White House.**

**Agree with me? Help me turn Virginia red this year.** The Commonwealth will be a decisive swing state this year -- if we put in the work.

[**JOIN THE TEAM -- TURN VIRGINIA RED!**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=008789d22bd14c34be4666968e54f7b7&_e=4W41HQl8Qm24hReaELapQFxzjglrDMlYbpV1xAlRDQmMANIdjUIVGxjJxYjUd9w3Bs8dzpQcUS9eBUkut_lEET1aIQE_02aRnbYRK-N_i2KKjSwEUCIcpdCQO6hcupyAeF666i_z4AR3yJ1HCzo4iVIOZhjgvyBsEj2OxMfbKikO_SOtGU43MUZhe1iLYyjr89GuLxC02o21g94W1ryeW6irSu6yIH6weD6foEU2dPY-vWMlV0ZIr7mMNuH8tjJk72Y94rpBxIpFTW4KDn4Ytjeld8TfecoE0GhCHPdSoWf85ovPVjBWf1UZ7tp9-vPwnf_m5COAHDLULW9VaJqWTLaXVDDnjldhMoZg0JFuyaDj_tp8qfhyEWB87Tyr-LgR7LPeZi3QyGF1HfDfoLTqBT04TMHoZMRtWDinaTuF3v4%3D)

body:
| | Trump will be in Michigan on Thursday for the 9th time since kicking off his 2024 campaign. It would mean A LOT to me if you would chip in today. It comes just a few days after a visit to Howell, Michigan — in my district — last week and a visit to Detroit on Monday. J.D. Vance is in Michigan today as well. I’ll explain why all of this is important in a moment. **[But first, I am asking for a contribution — $25 or whatever you can afford — before Donald Trump gets here. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to split a donation to Yassamin Ansari - the Democratic nominee for AZ-03 - and my campaign today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91646596/494528327/-1560229504?amount=25&refcode=240827_es_split_l1&ms=240827_es_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTA3MGIxMC1jOTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5-kytucETQKAYKA_16MRVFNl6LyIvDt5HUZuWqSTeiI=)** **[secure.actblue.com/donate/ya_es_em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91646599/494528336/-1560229504?amount=25&refcode=240827_es_split_l2&ms=240827_es_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTA3MGIxMC1jOTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5-kytucETQKAYKA_16MRVFNl6LyIvDt5HUZuWqSTeiI=)** Here's how former President Trump's visit plays in our race: We know that both the presidential race and the Senate majority will be decided by Michigan – and recent polls show that our race is a dead heat. Cook Political Report recently downgraded our race from “lean Democratic” to “toss up.” Given that the Senate race is the top of the ticket in the state, we know that whatever happens in our race will impact the presidential, too. That’s why Trump has given Mike Rogers his full-throated endorsement — and why he’s attacked me directly, by name, calling me a “far-left liberal lunatic.” We expect to hear that and more on Thursday, unfortunately. He knows that in order to win Michigan, the Republican nominee needs to win the Senate race – and he’s going to do whatever he can to make that happen. That means we can likely expect to see Trump in Michigan a lot — more in the home stretch. And National Republicans will be doing everything they can to flip our state red and boost our ultimate GOP opponent in the Senate race. In fact, there are already attack ads against me on TV — and we know more are on the way. Friend, I'm about to ask you to chip in every dollar you can to help Sherrod Brown win in Ohio and defend our Democratic Senate majority – but first, let me explain why this is so damn important for ALL of us. **[But hell, if you want to click here and chip in right away, I'm not gonna stop you.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91647178/494530314/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2643-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGQ3ZjdkYy1jYTY0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ur8LyOk2oOsao82g6QlPDKU4SSrxb4Xfsfrnerujo28=)**
I'll get right into it: Democrats have a razor-thin Senate majority, and **we're facing a NIGHTMARE Senate map. There's a strong chance it will all come down to Ohio, which means Sherrod is the ONLY thing standing between us and a Republican Senate.**
Friend, I've worked on campaigns for a long time. I've been on the winning side and the losing side. If there's one thing I know, it's that _money makes a BIG difference._ I wish it weren't the case, but it is. TV ads, phone banks, yard signs, campaign events in every corner of the state ... it all adds up FAST.
That's why I'm so terrified right now. If this were a simple battle between good and evil, I wouldn't be worried – Sherrod is as good a leader as Ohioans have ever had. He fights harder for workers than anybody I know, and he's not afraid to take on the big banks and corporations that are making things harder for the middle class.

subject: A beautiful world

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7316%2E5257348%2EJACFFU ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, it’s
David McMillan — Adam Schiff’s Little Brother.

The outcome of Adam’s race, the Senate and House majorities, and whether
we elect Kamala Harris or Donald Trump hang in the balance of the actions
we take in these final 10 weeks from now until November 5.

When I was 5 years old, my mother took me to the Big Brothers of Greater
Los Angeles and helped me fill out an application. In that application I
wished for three things: a Big Brother, a puppy, and a beautiful world.

Adam walked into that office one day to volunteer, and out of all of the
applications, he chose mine.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240827_PM2_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7316%2E5257348%2EJACFFU ]Adam and David

From our very first day together playing in the waves on the beach in
Venice, to Adam’s wedding, my Yale graduation, his elections to the State
Senate and Congress, and managing Trump’s first impeachment trial, Adam
and I have been there for each other at every big moment.

I’m not so “little” anymore, but Adam and I still refer to each other as
brothers — because in all of the important ways, we’re family.

And in Adam and Vice President Kamala Harris’s campaigns, I can see the
beautiful world we can create together — the one that I wished for all of
those years ago.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240827_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=5&t=1005&akid=7316%2E5257348%2EJACFFU ]But we need to stand with Adam and have his back today before his
important August fundraising deadline so that he has the resources to get
it done and win this race. Please,
Derek, I am humbly asking —
will you pitch in
$5?

subject: This is happening at the wrong time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, www
body:
We’ve got good news and bad news.
---
Derek, we’ve got good news and bad news. **We’ll start with the good** : During the Democratic National Convention last week, we saw a surge in individual donations. It was truly incredible. That’s money that we’re putting to work immediately reaching as many voters as possible before early voting begins. **But here’s the bad news** : In recent days, we’ve seen a significant slowdown in donations. The timing couldn’t be worse. Especially because our most important FEC deadline yet is coming up in a matter of days, and in some states, early voting kicks off right after that. Look at this chart: | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em_20240827_1060_fr&amount=15&refcode2=1060_22930333_a5Ixew&akid=1060%2E22930333%2Ea5Ixew)
---
The blue line is the amount of money we’ve raised, and the purple line is the number of donations. You can see the dropoff after the convention.
**So we have two choices to catch up.** We’ll either need _a lot_ more individual donations, or we’ll need Democrats who understand the importance of this moment to give a little bit more when they chip in.
Derek, normally we ask people making their first donation of the cycle to give $3 or $7. But today, we are asking you to pitch in a little bit more at this critical time -- $15 if you can. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to pitch in, this is it.
[**Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats running for office up and down the ballot are hoping you can donate $15 directly to the Democratic Party today. All of them deserve the attention they’re receiving, but we want to talk for a moment about **_why this Secretary of State race is so important._** [**If you don’t have time to read all the way through, please consider donating to Jesse James Mullen’s campaign for Secretary of State today.**](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=790b9f5b1f1348ff89ca16e5a36ab3cc&_e=IC-KuPF0VUOgjyIsnVOtJJog80CcqLsnkTP8ChPi_s_vDmaKz6UVzCA02EqiaEvX6HX8cli5FF-Iy381lk97UwR2L20ircIutXG-U_rc0aopHl2D4aeUIbkOOxYRBUW9qTk4k7vMSdQLOSRRuj2m1pW8MS7hW94Bb9JyIR_CpuVG6MDCGO659VWuMJPcRcFmjOTVkWeeh0rhYrgg8QfnIAmxtEAIRC5u1qvLRqDr-9bm_cDlkxwpzIF0K3XUXR9wVWrSsA3EPDbS07vpRtxQZI38ttkT_Y6KJjzWDAkFFl9DE5_y4_WCcRzvgEiI2kKaOufGCktoEJ2amtgaTx9AjrcWxmHF85qEGmHw_S4hE2BDqpdY9aLy7chRidLAkEB9QiZsRkx7FdK6PRGtycI8qunmMTxTfWPfsQ84YjuRj4g%3D) Montana has a long history of running clean and secure elections. In fact, we hold some of the best-run elections in the country. And the Secretary of State is supposed to be responsible for upholding that track record. Considering the moment we’re in as a state and country, with election denialism and conspiracy theories running amok from top to bottom of our politics (not to mention Jesse’s opponent being endorsed by election-denier-in-chief Donald Trump) – it’s never been more important to run strong elections and instill confidence in our election integrity. **Christi Jacobsen isn’t inspiring confidence in our system.
